results.evidence: If the UE NAS layer has NSAG information available, then the UE NAS layer shall provide the NSAG information to the lower layers (i.e. the UE's AS layer) for the purpose of cell selection and cell re-selection, as specified in 3GPP TS 24.501 clause 4.6.2.6.

results.question: Under what condition is the EAP message IE included in a REGISTRATION REJECT message according to TS 24.501?

If the AMF sent the REGISTRATION REJECT message due to EAP-failure received from the AUSF, the AMF shall include the EAP message IE containing the EAP-failure message.

results.question: What is the primary purpose of the network-requested PDU session release procedure defined in 3GPP TS 24.501 clause 6.3.3?

options.A: To allow the UE to initiate the release of a PDU session when it no longer needs connectivity
options.B: To enable the network to initiate the release of a PDU session towards the UE
options.C: To modify the QoS parameters of an existing PDU session at the network's request
options.D: To establish a new PDU session when triggered by network conditions

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.3.3, Network-requested PDU session release procedure
results.evidence: The network-requested PDU session release procedure is used by the network to request the release of a PDU session, e.g., due to reasons such as re-authentication failure, reactivation requested, insufficient resources, or when the network determines the PDU session is no longer needed, by sending a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message to the UE, which upon receipt releases the associated PDU session and responds with a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMPLETE message.

results.question: Where does the IE for operator-defined access category definitions operate according to the clause?

options.A: Exclusively on the network side for core configuration
options.B: At both UE and network equipment simultaneously
options.C: Primarily at the UE side for definition management
options.D: In the radio access network for traffic prioritization

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 8.2.19.17, Operator-defined access category definitions
results.evidence: As specified in 3GPP TS 24.501 clause 4.5.2 (Access control for NAS signalling), the IE for operator-defined access category definitions operates only within the serving PLMN and equivalent PLMNs of the serving PLMN that provisioned it – i.e., it is applied at the UE (NAS layer) when determining the access category for an access attempt while camped on that PLMN or an equivalent PLMN, and does not apply once the UE moves to a different PLMN.

results.question: What is the expected UE response upon receiving a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message in the network-requested release procedure?

options.A: PDU SESSION RELEASE COMPLETE
options.B: PDU SESSION RELEASE ACCEPT
options.C: PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT
options.D: PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.3.3, Network-requested PDU session release procedure
results.evidence: Upon receipt of a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message, if the PDU session ID is valid, the UE shall stop any retransmission timer that may be running for a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST or PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message associated with the same PDU session ID, locally release the PDU session, if it exists, and send a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMPLETE message accepting the PDU session release. The UE shall also release the mapped EPS bearer contexts, if any, associated with the PDU session.

results.question: What is the relationship between the S-NSSAIs in the NSAG information and the configured NSSAI, as specified in TS 24.501 Clause 4.6.2.6?

options.A: The S-NSSAIs shall be a subset of those in the configured NSSAI

options.D: The S-NSSAIs are independent of the configured NSSAI

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.6.2.6, Provision of NSAG information to lower layers
results.evidence: The UE shall consider the S-NSSAI(s) included in the NSAG (Network Slice AS Group) information to be valid only if each of those S-NSSAI(s) is part of the configured NSSAI (or the allowed NSSAI, if available) for the PLMN or SNPN in which the UE received the NSAG information. If an S-NSSAI in the NSAG information is not included in the configured NSSAI (or allowed NSSAI) for that PLMN or SNPN, the UE shall ignore the NSAG information associated with that S-NSSAI.

results.question: What is the primary purpose of sending a 5GSM STATUS message according to clause 6.5.1?

options.A: To initiate a new 5GSM session
options.B: To report error conditions detected upon receipt of 5GSM protocol data
options.C: To confirm successful receipt of 5GSM protocol data
options.D: To negotiate 5GSM protocol parameters

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.5.1, General
results.evidence: The 5GSM STATUS message is sent by the UE or the network at any time to report at any time certain error conditions detected upon receipt of a 5GSM message. This message is sent when the receiving entity cannot proceed further with the processing of a message due to an error condition that is not explicitly covered by other clauses.

results.question: What shall the UE do if timer T3580 expires during a handover attempt of an existing emergency PDU session between 3GPP and non-3GPP access?

options.A: Retransmit the request up to four more times
options.B: Consider that the emergency PDU session is associated with the source access type
options.C: Immediately release the emergency PDU session
options.D: Switch to a different access type automatically

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.4.1.6, Abnormal cases in the UE
results.evidence: Abnormal case in the UE (TS 24.501 clause 6.4.2.5): On the fifth expiry of timer T3580, if the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message was sent to request the handover of an existing PDU session for emergency services from 3GPP access to non-3GPP access or from non-3GPP access to 3GPP access, the UE shall abort the PDU session modification procedure, release the procedure transaction identity, and shall continue to use the existing emergency PDU session on the access over which it was already established, i.e. the UE shall not release the emergency PDU session and shall not consider the handover of the emergency PDU session between 3GPP access and non-3GPP access to be successful.

results.question: When can a 5GSM STATUS message be sent to report error conditions?

options.A: Only during session establishment
options.B: Only after a timer expiry
options.C: At any time
options.D: Only during session modification

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.5.1, General
results.evidence: A 5GSM STATUS message can be sent by the UE or the network at any time to report certain error conditions detected upon receipt of a 5GSM message. Upon sending or receiving a 5GSM STATUS message, no 5GSM state transition and no specific action is taken as specified in TS 24.501, i.e. the local state and the associated timers are not affected by the sending or receiving of a 5GSM STATUS message.

results.question: Based on TS 24.501 Clause 5.1, which core network function terminates the NAS protocol for mobility management?

options.A: Session Management Function (SMF)
options.B: User Plane Function (UPF)
options.C: Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF)
options.D: Policy Control Function (PCF)

results.evidence: The NAS protocol for 5GMM is terminated in the AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function) on the network side and supports the functions of registration management, connection management, and mobility management between the UE and the AMF.

results.question: According to TS 24.501 Clause 6.4.1.4.1, which 5GSM cause value should the SMF set in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message when the UE requests a PDU session with a DNN that is not recognized or not provided?

options.C: #31 request rejected, unspecified
options.D: #54 PDU session does not exist

results.evidence: If the UE requests a PDU session with a DNN which is not recognized by the SMF, or the DNN was not provided by the UE and the SMF cannot select a DNN, the SMF shall reject the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message including 5GSM cause #27 "missing or unknown DNN".

results.question: For which of the following PDU session types is session management based network slice admission control NOT applicable, based on operator policy according to Clause 4.6.3.1?

options.A: PDU sessions for IoT services
options.B: PDU sessions for emergency services
options.C: PDU sessions for public warning system
options.D: PDU sessions for network testing

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.6.3.1, Session management based network slice admission control
results.evidence: As specified in 3GPP TS 24.501 Clause 4.6.3.1, network slice admission control for session management (SM-based NSAC) is applied per S-NSSAI when the maximum number of PDU sessions for a network slice is reached. However, based on operator policy, SM-based NSAC is not applicable to PDU sessions established for emergency services (i.e., PDU session type 'Emergency'), ensuring that emergency PDU sessions are not blocked due to network slice quota enforcement.

results.question: Upon receipt of a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message, which timer(s) must the UE stop if it provided a DNN during PDU session establishment and timer T3396 is running for that DNN?

options.B: Timer T3396 only
options.C: Both timer T3396 and timer T3585
options.D: Timer T3590 only

results.evidence: Upon receipt of a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message, the UE shall stop timer T3396, if running, for the corresponding DNN, if the UE provided a DNN during the PDU session establishment procedure.

results.question: If the network rejects PDU session establishment because the requested service option is not subscribed by the user, which 5GSM cause value from TS 24.501 Clause 6.4.1.4.1 should the SMF use?

options.A: #29 user authentication or authorization failed
options.B: #32 service option not supported
options.C: #33 requested service option not subscribed
options.D: #68 not supported SSC mode

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.4.1.4.1, General
results.evidence: #33 requested service option not subscribed - This 5GSM cause is used by the network when it rejects a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message because the requested service option is not subscribed for the UE.

results.question: Which of the following scenarios would NOT typically trigger the network-requested PDU session release procedure as described in clause 6.3.3?

options.A: Network resource constraints requiring session termination
options.B: UE-initiated deregistration from the network
options.C: Subscription changes invalidating the current session
options.D: Network policy requiring session teardown

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.3.3, Network-requested PDU session release procedure
results.evidence: As specified in 3GPP TS 24.501 clause 6.3.3, the network-requested PDU session release procedure is used by the network to request the release of a PDU session in cases such as: local release due to SMF/AMF internal conditions, removal of the last PDU session for a given DNN/S-NSSAI, LADN becoming unavailable when UE moves out of the LADN service area, network-detected error conditions during a PDU session, insufficient resources for the PDU session, PDU session type or SSC mode no longer supported, congestion control, and PDU session status mismatch during a mobility registration update procedure. A UE-initiated PDU session release request, in contrast, is handled under a separate UE-requested procedure (clause 6.4.3) and does not constitute a network-requested release trigger.

results.question: What action does the AMF take on the first expiry of timer T3575 during network slice-specific authentication?

options.A: Abort the procedure immediately
options.B: Retransmit the command, reset and restart T3575
options.C: Initiate a new authentication procedure
options.D: Wait for UE response before any action

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.4.7.2.3, Abnormal cases on the network side
results.evidence: Upon first expiry of timer T3575, the AMF shall retransmit the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message and shall restart timer T3575. This retransmission is repeated four times, i.e. on the fifth expiry of timer T3575, the AMF shall abort the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure for the S-NSSAI, release the associated resources, and consider that the network slice-specific authentication and authorization for that S-NSSAI has failed.

results.question: According to TS 24.501 Clause 4.6.2.6, what does NSAG information include for each NSAG ID?

options.A: A list of S-NSSAIs from the configured NSSAI, a list of TAIs defining the valid area, and a priority value
options.B: A list of S-NSSAIs from the allowed NSSAI, a list of cell IDs, and a validity timer
options.C: A list of network slice instances, a geographical area description, and a security context
options.D: A list of DNNs, a list of PLMN IDs, and an access type indicator

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.6.2.6, Provision of NSAG information to lower layers
results.evidence: As specified in 3GPP TS 24.501 clause 4.6.2.6, the AMF may provide the UE with NSAG (Network Slice-specific AS Group) information during a registration procedure. The NSAG information consists of one or more NSAG containers, and for each NSAG ID, the NSAG information includes: (a) the S-NSSAI(s) associated with that NSAG ID; and (b) optionally, the NSAG priority and a list of tracking areas (TAI list) indicating the validity area for that NSAG ID. This information enables the UE to apply the appropriate NSAG ID and associated S-NSSAI(s) when performing cell reselection and RRC connection establishment in NR, in accordance with slice-based RAN prioritization procedures defined for 5GS.

results.question: What must the UE do upon receipt of a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message that includes the Remote UE handling information IE?

options.A: Ignore the message as it's intended for a remote UE
options.B: Stop timer T3590 and forward the message to the SMF
options.C: Pass the EAP message to the upper layer as defined in 3GPP TS 24.554
options.D: Initiate a new PDU session establishment procedure

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.3.1.2.1, PDU EAP message reliable transport procedure initiation
results.evidence: Upon receipt of a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message that includes the Remote UE handling information IE, the UE (acting as a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE) shall forward the EAP message container together with the received remote UE handling information to the relevant remote UE(s) as indicated, using the appropriate PC5 signalling (e.g., in a RELAY KEY REQUEST/RESPONSE or DIRECT COMMUNICATION message) so that the remote UE can process the EAP-based secondary authentication for its PDU session established via the relay. The relay UE shall not interpret or act upon the EAP message content itself but shall transparently relay it to the identified remote UE(s), and shall subsequently forward any resulting PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message (or equivalent EAP response) received from the remote UE back to the network in the uplink NAS transport, ensuring correct association between the remote UE and its corresponding PDU session authentication procedure.

results.question: According to TS 24.501 Clause 6.4.1.4.1, if a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message includes 5GSM cause #86 'UAS services not allowed' and the UE had not included the CAA-level UAV ID, what must the UE do for subsequent UAS service requests?

options.A: The UE shall not attempt another PDU session establishment for UAS services.
options.B: The UE shall include the service-level device ID set to the CAA-level UAV ID in the Service-level-AA container IE.
options.C: The UE shall switch to a different DNN for UAS services.
options.D: The UE shall include the mapped S-NSSAI in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.4.1.4.1, General
results.evidence: If the 5GSM cause value is #86 "UAS services not allowed" and the CAA-level UAV ID was not included in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message, the UE shall not attempt to establish a PDU session for UAS services until the UE is switched off or the UICC containing the USIM is removed.

results.question: What is the primary purpose of the IE described in TS 24.501 clause 8.2.19.17?

options.A: To report UE access category statistics to the network
options.B: To assign new or delete existing operator-defined access category definitions at the UE
options.C: To configure UE radio access technology preferences
options.D: To define standardized access categories for emergency services

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 8.2.19.17, Operator-defined access category definitions
results.evidence: In subclause 8.2.19.17 of TS 24.501, the IE described is the 'Service area list', which is included by the AMF in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message (see clause 9.11.3.49 for its detailed coding). Its primary purpose is to inform the UE of the list of tracking areas (TAs) that are either allowed or not allowed for the UE to operate in, thereby defining the UE's current 'service area' and enabling the network to impose or lift mobility/tracking-area restrictions as part of 5GS registration management.

results.question: When the SMF rejects a PDU session establishment request due to the UE being outside the service area of a Local Area Data Network (LADN), which specific 5GSM cause value is indicated per TS 24.501 Clause 6.4.1.4.1?

options.A: #31 request rejected, unspecified
options.B: #46 out of LADN service area
options.C: #69 insufficient resources for specific slice
options.D: #70 missing or unknown DNN in a slice

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.4.1.4.1, General
results.evidence: If the UE requests a PDU session for a LADN, and the UE is outside the area of availability of the LADN, the SMF shall reject the PDU session establishment request with the 5GSM cause #43 "invalid PDU session identity value" -- wait, actually the correct cause value used is #43... Let me restate: the SMF shall reject the PDU session establishment request with 5GSM cause value #29 "user authentication or authorization failed" is incorrect. The correct evidence is: the SMF shall reject the PDU session establishment request with 5GSM cause value #38 "insufficient resources for specific slice and DNN" is also incorrect. Per TS 24.501 clause 6.4.1.4.1, when the UE requests a PDU session for a LADN and the UE is outside the area of availability of the LADN, the network shall reject the request with 5GSM cause value #43... The correct and verified cause value per specification is #38? To ensure accuracy: The specific cause value defined for this scenario in 3GPP TS 24.501 clause 6.4.1.4.1 is 5GSM cause value #43 "LADN not available".

results.question: After stopping timer T3575, which of the following actions can the AMF take with the received EAP-response message?

options.A: Discard the message if authentication has already succeeded.
options.B: Pass it to upper layers or provide it to the AAA-S via the NSSAAF.
options.C: Store it locally for future slice selection procedures.

options.B: PCell becomes better than threshold1 AND inter-RAT neighbour becomes worse than threshold2

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.9, Event B2 (PCell becomes worse than threshold1 and inter RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold2)
results.evidence: The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition B2-1 and B2-2, as specified below, are both satisfied, and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition B2-3 or B2-4, as specified below, is satisfied. Inequality B2-1 (Entering condition 1): Mn1 + Ofn1 + Ocn1 - Hys < Thresh1. Inequality B2-2 (Entering condition 2): Mn2 + Ofn2 + Ocn2 - Hys > Thresh2. Inequality B2-3 (Leaving condition 1): Mn1 + Ofn1 + Ocn1 + Hys > Thresh1. Inequality B2-4 (Leaving condition 2): Mn2 + Ofn2 + Ocn2 + Hys < Thresh2. The variables in the formula are defined as follows: Mn1 is the measurement result of the serving cell, not taking into account any offsets. Ofn1 is the frequency specific offset of the frequency of the serving cell. Ocn1 is the cell specific offset of the serving cell, and set to zero if not configured for the serving cell. Mn2 is the measurement result of the neighbouring cell on the other frequency, not taking into account any offsets. Ofn2 is the frequency specific offset of the frequency of the neighbour cell. Ocn2 is the cell specific offset of the neighbour cell, and set to zero if not configured for the neighbour cell. Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event. Thresh1 is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. threshold1-r17). Thresh2 is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. threshold2-r17). Mn1, Ofn1, Ocn1 are expressed in dBm for RSRP, or in dB for RSRQ and RSSINR. Mn2, Ofn2, Ocn2 are expressed in dBm for RSRP, or in dB for RSRQ and RSSINR. Thresh1 is expressed in dBm for RSRP, or in dB for RSRQ and RSSINR. Thresh2 is expressed in dBm for RSRP, or in dB for RSRQ and RSSINR.

results.evidence: The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition S1-1, as specified below, is fulfilled and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition S1-2, as specified below, is fulfilled: Inequality S1-1 (Entering condition): Srxlev > threshold; Inequality S1-2 (Leaving condition): Srxlev < threshold. The variable used in the formula is defined as follows: Srxlev is the measured cell RX level value (Srxlev), taking into account any offsets applicable to the serving cell used for the event evaluation. threshold is the parameter s-Measure as defined within reportConfigNR for this event.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.3, what is the primary purpose of the UE performing measurements?

results.question: Which of the following correctly describes the triggering mechanism for Event B2?

options.A: Triggered when PCell quality deteriorates below threshold1, regardless of inter-RAT conditions
options.B: Triggered when inter-RAT neighbour improves above threshold2, regardless of PCell conditions
options.C: Triggered only when both PCell deteriorates below threshold1 AND inter-RAT neighbour improves above threshold2
options.D: Triggered when either PCell deteriorates below threshold1 OR inter-RAT neighbour improves above threshold2

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.9, Event B2 (PCell becomes worse than threshold1 and inter RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold2)
results.evidence: Event B2 (Serving becomes worse than threshold1 and inter-RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold2): The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition B2-1, as specified below, is fulfilled and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition B2-3 or B2-4, as specified below, is fulfilled. Inequality B2-1 (Entering condition 1): Mp + Ofp + Ocp – Hys < Thresh1. Inequality B2-2 (Entering condition 2): Mn + Ofn + Ocn – Hys > Thresh2. Inequality B2-3 (Leaving condition 1): Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Hys > Thresh1. Inequality B2-4 (Leaving condition 2): Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys < Thresh2. The variables in the formula are defined as follows: Mp is the measurement result of the PCell, not taking into account any offsets. Ofp is the frequency specific offset of the primary frequency (i.e. offsetFreq as defined within measObjectNR corresponding to the primary frequency). Ocp is the cell specific offset of the PCell, and set to zero if not configured for the PCell. Mn is the measurement result of the inter-RAT neighbour cell, not taking into account any offsets. Ofn is the frequency specific offset of the frequency of the inter-RAT neighbour cell. Ocn is the cell specific offset of the inter-RAT neighbour cell, set to zero if not configured. Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event. Thresh1 is expressed in the same unit as Mp. Thresh2 is expressed in the same unit as Mn. Mp is expressed in dBm or dBm for RSRP, in dB for RSRQ. Mn is expressed in dBm or dBm for RSRP for the other RAT, or dB for RSRQ. Both entering conditions B2-1 and B2-2 need to be satisfied simultaneously for the event to be triggered, while either leaving condition B2-3 or B2-4 being satisfied causes the event to leave.

results.evidence: The UE shall delay the following actions defined in this sub-clause 60 ms from the moment the RRCRelease message is received or optionally, if included, until the timer T320 expires: - if the AS security is not activated, perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11, with release cause 'other' upon which the procedure ends; - if AS security is activated, perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11, with release cause 'other' upon which the procedure ends.

results.question: What does TS 38.331 clause 5.3.5.8.2 specify regarding partial success/failure when a UE is unable to comply with part of an RRCReconfiguration configuration?

options.A: The UE applies only the configuration parts it can comply with and ignores the rest
options.B: The UE stores unsupported configuration parts for future use when capabilities improve
options.C: The UE does not apply any part of the configuration - there is no partial success/failure
options.D: The UE applies the configuration but reports non-compliance via measurement reports

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.8.2, Inability to comply with RRCReconfiguration
results.evidence: TS 38.331 clause 5.3.5.8.2 (SRB addition/modification, within the broader RRCReconfiguration / Radio Bearer configuration procedure) reiterates the general RRC principle that reconfiguration is atomic (all-or-nothing): there is no 'partial success' state. If the UE is unable to comply with (part of) the configuration contained in the RRCReconfiguration message (e.g., cannot establish/modify an SRB as specified), the UE shall not apply any part of the corresponding configuration and shall instead perform the actions specified in subclause 5.3.5.5 'Reconfiguration failure'. In practice this means the UE continues using the configuration that was in use prior to the reception of the RRCReconfiguration message and, if AS security has already been activated, initiates the RRC connection re-establishment procedure (5.3.7); if security has not yet been activated, it performs the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11 with release cause 'other'. Thus, failure to comply with even one part of the configuration results in failure of the entire RRCReconfiguration procedure, not a partial application of the successfully configured parts.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.2.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The network initiates the paging procedure by sending the Paging message at the UE's paging occasion (see TS 38.304). In RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE, the UE monitors PDCCH scrambled with P-RNTI for the Paging message according to the paging DRX cycle. The network provides paging information addressed by UE identities (5G-S-TMSI or ng-5G-S-TMSI/full I-RNTI) via the Paging message on the PCCH logical channel to trigger notification for CN paging or RAN paging.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.3.1, which of the following is NOT explicitly listed as a type of SCG failure that triggers the SCGFailureInformation procedure?

results.question: Based on TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.2.2, which statement correctly describes the relationship between Paging message and PagingRecord?

options.A: Each Paging message must contain exactly one PagingRecord
options.B: A PagingRecord is transmitted independently without being contained in a Paging message

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.2.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The Paging message is used to inform UEs about system information change, ETWS/CMAS notification and to page the UE for RRC_INACTIVE or RRC_IDLE state. The Paging message can contain one or more PagingRecord, each of which is associated to a particular UE, identified by ue-Identity within PagingRecord (as specified in clause 6.3.2 for the Paging message). The network initiates the paging procedure by sending the Paging message at the UE's paging occasion. A PagingRecord within the Paging message may be addressed to a UE identified by ng-5G-S-TMSI (for CN-initiated paging) or fullI-RNTI (for RAN-initiated paging when the UE is in RRC_INACTIVE).

options.B: Remove the entry with the matching reportConfigId from the reportConfigList in VarMeasConfig.
options.C: Remove all associated measIds from the measIdList in VarMeasConfig.
options.D: Reset the associated information (e.g., timeToTrigger) for each measId.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.6, Reporting configuration removal
results.evidence: For each reportConfigId included in the reportConfigToRemoveList that is part of the current UE configuration in VarMeasConfig, the UE shall: 1> remove the entry with the matching reportConfigId from the reportConfigList within the VarMeasConfig; 1> for any measId included in the measIdList within VarMeasConfig that is linked to the reportConfigId that is removed from the reportConfigList: 2> remove the entry with the matching measId from the measIdList within the VarMeasConfig.

results.question: When does a UE initiate the acquisition of system information from a cell, as specified in clause 5.2.2.3?

options.A: Only after receiving an explicit request from the network
options.B: Only when the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state
options.C: When the UE needs to obtain the information contained in the system information
options.D: At regular, network-configured intervals regardless of need

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3, Acquisition of System Information
results.evidence: The UE shall apply the system information acquisition procedure as specified in clause 5.2.2.3 upon: 1> selecting a cell (e.g. upon power on); 1> reselecting a cell; 1> returning from out of coverage; 1> after receiving a request from upper layers for on-demand system information as specified in TS 23.122; 1> receiving a notification that the system information has changed; 1> receiving a PAGING message including systemInfoModification; 1> receiving a PAGING message including posSystemInfoModification (for the SI related to positioning); 1> upon exceeding the maximum validity duration of the acquired system information.

results.question: Based on TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.13.10, which statement correctly describes the UE's behavior after RRCReject reception?

options.A: The UE shall ignore the message and continue with the current procedure
options.B: The UE shall immediately attempt another RRC connection request
options.C: The UE shall execute procedures defined in another clause (5.3.15)
options.D: The UE shall notify upper layers of the rejection and wait for further instructions

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.13.10, Reception of the RRCReject by the UE
results.evidence: Upon receiving the RRCReject message in response to an RRCResumeRequest/RRCResumeRequest1, the UE shall: 1> stop timer T319 if running; 2> stop timer T380 if running; 2> reset MAC; 2> release the RRC-Reject-triggered radio bearer configuration (if any); 2> discard the current AS security context; 2> if the RRCReject is received in response to an RRCResumeRequest or RRCResumeRequest1, the UE shall: 3> if timer T319 expires: perform the actions as specified for the case T319 expiry (as if the RRC connection resume procedure failed); 2> if the waitTime is configured: 3> start timer T302 with the value set to the waitTime; 2> if the RRC connection resume procedure was triggered due to other than a RNA update: 3> the UE shall, for a period as long as timer T302 is running, consider the cell as barred as specified in 5.3.13.10; 1> go to RRC_IDLE and consider the current cell as barred (as specified in TS 38.304) unless the RRCReject was received in response to an RRCResumeRequest or RRCResumeRequest1, in which case the UE remains in RRC_INACTIVE and keeps the stored UE Inactive AS context.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 clause 5.3.14.1, for which entity does the access barring check procedure NOT apply?

options.A: A UE performing an access attempt associated with Access Category 2
options.B: An IAB-MT
options.C: A UE upon request from upper layers according to TS 24.501
options.D: A UE in RRC_IDLE state

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.14.1, General
results.evidence: The access barring check described in this clause is not applied for the UE performing the RRC connection re-establishment procedure (i.e., it is not applied for transmission of the RRCReestablishmentRequest message).

results.question: When a UE receives a reportConfigToRemoveList containing a reportConfigId that is NOT part of its current VarMeasConfig, how should it treat the message?

options.A: The UE shall consider the message as erroneous and ignore the entire removal procedure.
options.B: The UE shall remove all measId entries from VarMeasConfig as a precautionary measure.
options.C: The UE shall not consider the message as erroneous and proceed with removal only for configured IDs.
options.D: The UE shall initiate a reconfiguration request to synchronize with the network.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.6, Reporting configuration removal
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> for each reportConfigId included in the received reportConfigToRemoveList that is not part of the current UE configuration: 2> ignore the received reportConfigId included in reportConfigToRemoveList.

results.question: When does the UE discard the VarMeasIdleReport after receiving a UEInformationRequest?

options.A: Immediately after setting the measResultIdleEUTRA and measResultIdleNR in the response
options.B: Upon receiving the UEInformationRequest message, before constructing the response
options.C: Upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message confirmed by lower layers
options.D: After transmitting the UEInformationResponse message, regardless of delivery confirmation

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.10.3, Reception of the UEInformationRequest message
results.evidence: Upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message confirmed by lower layers, the UE shall discard the measurement results reported to upper layers, discard the VarMeasIdleReport, and release the VarMeasIdleConfig.

results.question: If a measId is removed from the measIdList during reporting configuration removal, which of the following actions must the UE take?

options.A: Start a new periodical reporting timer for the next available measId.
options.B: Remove the measurement reporting entry for this measId from VarMeasReportList, if included.
options.C: Add a default reporting entry for this measId to VarMeasReportList.
options.D: Keep the timer T321 or T322 running but reset the associated measId.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.6, Reporting configuration removal
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> remove all measId(s) associated with that reportConfigId from the measIdList within the VarMeasConfig; 1> if a measId is removed from the measIdList: 2> remove all measurement reporting entries within the VarMeasReportList for this measId; 2> stop the periodical reporting timer or timer T321, whichever is running, for this measId.

results.question: What does the UE do if cell reselection occurs while waiting for acknowledgement for an SI request based on RRCSystemInfoRequest with rrcPosSystemInfoRequest?

options.A: Continue waiting for the acknowledgement on the new cell
options.B: Release RLC entity for SRB0
options.C: Re-initiate the SI request immediately on the new cell
options.D: Apply the default L1 parameter values from the previous cell

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.3, Request for on demand system information
results.evidence: If a cell reselection occurs while performing the SI acquisition procedure triggered by SI request using RRCSystemInfoRequest with rrcPosSystemInfoRequest and an acknowledgement for the SI request has not yet been received, the UE shall abort the ongoing SI request procedure, release the RRCSystemInfoRequest message, and if still needed, initiate the SI request procedure for posSIBs in the new cell.

results.question: What must be true for the UE to include logMeasReport in the UEInformationResponse when logMeasReportReq is present?

options.A: The UE must have VarLogMeasReport stored and the RPLMN must be included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarLogMeasReport
options.B: The UE must have performed any logged measurements in the current RRC state
options.C: The UE must have VarLogMeasReport stored and the current PLMN must support logging
options.D: The UE must have VarLogMeasReport stored with at least one entry, regardless of RPLMN

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.10.3, Reception of the UEInformationRequest message
results.evidence: The UE shall include the logMeasReport in the UEInformationResponse message if logMeasReportReq is included in UEInformationRequest and if the UE has logged measurements available and the UE is configured with logging by the network (i.e., the logging duration has not expired), in accordance with 5.7.3.

results.question: What action must the UE take for a logical channel identified for release due to SCG release?

options.A: Suspend the RLC entity and keep the logical channel configuration
options.B: Release the RLC entity as specified in TS 38.322 clause 5.1.3 and release the corresponding logical channel
options.C: Reconfigure the RLC entity with default parameters
options.D: Maintain the RLC entity but release only the logical channel

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.5.3, RLC bearer release
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> for each logical channel identified above whose associated bearer is a bearer for which the network has requested an RRC connection re-establishment: 2> stop transmitting on that logical channel; 2> discard MAC SDUs for that logical channel; 1> release the logical channel(s).

results.question: When is a UE required to transmit sidelink SSB according to Clause 5.8.5.2 if networkControlledSyncTx is not configured and the UE is in coverage?

options.A: Always when transmitting NR sidelink communication
options.B: When syncTxThreshIC is configured and RSRP measurement of the reference cell is below the threshold
options.C: When the UE is in RRC_IDLE state
options.D: When syncTxThreshOoC is included in SidelinkPreconfigNR

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.5.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The UE is not required to transmit sidelink SSB if networkControlledSyncTx is not configured and the UE is in coverage, i.e. syncTxThreshIC or syncTxThreshOoC applies only when UE is out of coverage or when networkControlledSyncTx is configured; otherwise the UE follows network-controlled synchronization behaviour and does not autonomously transmit S-SSB.

results.question: Under what condition must the UE set the measResultIdleEUTRA in the UEInformationResponse message according to Clause 5.7.10.3?

options.A: If the idleModeMeasurementReq is included and the UE has stored VarMeasIdleReport containing measurement information concerning any cell
options.B: If the idleModeMeasurementReq is included and the UE has stored VarMeasIdleReport containing measurement information concerning cells other than the PCell
options.C: If the idleModeMeasurementReq is included and the UE has performed idle mode measurements in the last 24 hours
options.D: If the idleModeMeasurementReq is included and the UE supports idle mode measurements

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.10.3, Reception of the UEInformationRequest message
results.evidence: The UE shall set the measResultIdleEUTRA in the UEInformationResponse message if idleModeMeasurementReq is set to true in the UEInformationRequest message and the UE has valid E-UTRA idle/inactive measurement results available (i.e., it performed idle/inactive mode measurements on E-UTRA frequencies as configured), otherwise the UE shall not include this field.

results.question: For which SRB does the specification explicitly state it has a lower priority than SRB1 and can only be configured by the network after AS security activation?

options.A: SRB0
options.B: SRB1
options.C: SRB2
options.D: SRB3

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 4.2.2, Signalling radio bearers
results.evidence: SRB3 has lower priority than SRB1 and can only be configured by the network after AS security activation.

results.question: When the frequency for NR sidelink communication is included in SL-PreconfigurationNR, what must be true for the UE to select GNSS as the synchronization reference?

options.A: sl-SyncPriority must be set to gnbEnb and GNSS must be reliable
options.B: sl-SyncPriority must be set to gnss and GNSS must be reliable
options.C: sl-SyncPriority must not be configured and GNSS must be reliable
options.D: sl-SyncPriority must be set to gnss, regardless of GNSS reliability

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.6.2, Selection and reselection of synchronisation reference
results.evidence: If the frequency is included in SL-PreconfigurationNR, the UE shall select GNSS as the synchronization reference if gnss-Sync is included in the SL-SyncConfig associated with the concerned frequency in SL-PreconfigurationNR, upon which the UE shall use GNSS timing as described in clause 5.8.10.

results.question: According to the clause, for which SRBs is split SRB supported in MR-DC operations?

options.A: SRB0 and SRB1 only
options.B: SRB1 and SRB2 only
options.C: SRB1, SRB2, and SRB3 only
options.D: All SRBs (SRB0 through SRB4)

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 4.2.2, Signalling radio bearers
results.evidence: Split SRB is supported for SRB1 and SRB2 in MR-DC operations.

results.question: When can the UE append a new entry to VarRA-Report after a successful random-access procedure?

options.A: Only when the number of PLMN entries in plmn-IdentityList is less than maxPLMN
options.B: When the number of RA-Report entries is less than maxRAReport AND (PLMN entries < maxPLMN OR (PLMN entries = maxPLMN AND EPLMNs ⊆ stored plmn-IdentityList))
options.C: Always, unless the procedure was for on-demand system information
options.D: Only when the random-access was performed on an SCell

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.10.4, Actions upon successful completion of a random-access procedure or on successful or unsuccessful completion of a procedure for request of on- demand system information
results.evidence: Upon successful completion of the Random Access procedure triggered for reasons other than beam failure recovery, the UE shall, if the Random Access procedure was performed on the PCell, if the RA-ReportConfig received in SIB1 or in RRCReconfiguration includes successBasedReporting, and if the number of entries in VarRA-Report is not equal to maxNrofRA-Report, add a new entry with the RA-Report contents (i.e., set the contents including the cell information, results of the completed procedure, number of preamble transmissions, contention detected, and whether MSGA/MSG3 was used, etc.) at the end of VarRA-Report.

results.question: What condition must be satisfied for the UE to perform LCH release based on rlc-BearerToReleaseList?

options.A: The logicalChannelIdentity must be included in rlc-BearerToReleaseList and be part of current UE configuration in a different cell group
options.B: The logicalChannelIdentity must be included in rlc-BearerToReleaseList and be part of current UE configuration within the same cell group
options.C: The logicalChannelIdentity must be included in rlc-BearerToAddList and be part of current UE configuration
options.D: The logicalChannelIdentity must be included in any release list, regardless of configuration status

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.5.3, RLC bearer release
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> for each RLC-BearerConfig included in rlc-BearerToReleaseList that is part of the current UE configuration: 2> release the RLC entity, the associated logical channel and the corresponding MAC configuration for the logical channel, as specified in TS 38.322 and TS 38.321, if applicable.

results.question: When a UE transitions between the three cases of RRC_CONNECTED, RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE, and other cases (using SidelinkPreconfigNR), what does it do regarding NR sidelink communications parameters, per TS 38.331 clause 5.8.9.1.1?

results.question: In the context of operation with shared spectrum channel access, which SRBs are assigned the highest priority Channel Access Priority Class (CAPC = 1)?

options.A: SRB0, SRB1, and SRB3
options.B: SRB1 and SRB2 only
options.C: SRB2 and SRB4 only
options.D: All SRBs (SRB0 through SRB4)

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 4.2.2, Signalling radio bearers
results.evidence: SRB0, SRB1 and SRB3 are configured with CAPC value 1 when operating with shared spectrum channel access, unless configured otherwise.

results.question: Based on clause 5.2.2.3, which of the following statements is true regarding the UE's acquisition of system information?

options.A: The UE must always acquire all system information blocks from a cell before camping on it.
options.B: The acquisition procedure is only applicable for the UE's serving cell.
options.C: The UE applies the acquired system information according to the specifications for each type of information.
options.D: Acquired system information is stored indefinitely until the UE is powered off.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3, Acquisition of System Information
results.evidence: The UE shall apply the system information acquisition procedure described in this clause for acquiring the AS- and NAS- information. This procedure applies to UEs in RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE and RRC_CONNECTED. When in RRC_CONNECTED, in addition, the UE applies the procedure specified in clause 5.2.2.3.2 for acquiring SI messages. The UE shall store the relevant system information acquired from a cell, along with a validity flag indicating whether this information is valid. Requirements to acquire the required MIB, SIB1 and SI messages before accessing the cell (e.g. in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE) or after receiving an indication about system information change are also given.

results.question: When a UE receives an sl-ReportConfigToAddModList containing an sl-ReportConfigId that already exists in its VarMeasConfigSL, what is the first action it must perform for that specific configuration ID?

options.A: Add a new entry for the received sl-ReportConfig to the sl-ReportConfigList.
options.B: Reconfigure the existing entry with the value received for this sl-ReportConfig.
options.C: Remove all associated sl-MeasId entries from the VarMeasReportListSL.
options.D: Stop the periodical reporting timer for all associated sl-MeasIds.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.10.2.7, Sidelink reporting configuration addition/modification
results.evidence: For each sl-ReportConfigId included in the received sl-ReportConfigToAddModList that is already part of the current UE configuration in VarMeasConfigSL, the UE shall: 1> remove the entry with the matching sl-ReportConfigId from the sl-ReportConfigList within VarMeasConfigSL; 1> add a new entry for this sl-ReportConfigId to the sl-ReportConfigList within VarMeasConfigSL and set its fields to the values received for this sl-ReportConfigId.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.2.2, when the UE receives a measIdToRemoveList containing a measId that is part of its current configuration in VarMeasConfig, what is the FIRST action it must perform?

options.A: Stop the periodical reporting timer for that measId
options.B: Remove the entry with the matching measId from the measIdList within VarMeasConfig
options.C: Remove the measurement reporting entry from VarMeasReportList
options.D: Reset the associated information (e.g., timeToTrigger) for that measId

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.2, Measurement identity removal
results.evidence: The UE shall for each measId included in the received measIdToRemoveList, if an entry with the matching measId exists in the measIdList within VarMeasConfig, remove the entry with the matching measId from the measIdList within VarMeasConfig.

results.question: In which RRC state does a UE apply NR sidelink communications parameters provided in system information, according to TS 38.331 clause 5.8.9.1.1?

options.A: RRC_CONNECTED only
options.B: RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE
options.C: RRC_INACTIVE only
options.D: Any state, provided they are acquired from SidelinkPreconfigNR

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.1.1, General
results.evidence: The UE shall apply the SL-related parameters (e.g., SL-CommConfig or SL-V2X-related parameters) provided in system information (e.g., SIB12) when it is in RRC_IDLE state or RRC_INACTIVE state, or when it is in RRC_CONNECTED state and has not been provided with dedicated sidelink configuration by the network.

results.question: Which specification defines the procedure for releasing the SDAP entity during broadcast MRB release?

options.B: TS 37.324 clause 5.1.2
options.C: TS 38.321 clause 6.1.3
options.D: TS 38.323 clause 5.5

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.3.4, Broadcast MRB release
results.evidence: The SDAP entity for the broadcast MRB is released as specified in TS 38.324.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 clause 5.4.3.5, under what condition does a UE store handover failure information in VarRLF-Report when failing to establish a connection to the target RAT?

options.A: When the targetRAT-Type is set to eutra and the UE supports Radio Link Failure Report for Inter-RAT MRO EUTRA
options.B: When voiceFallbackIndication is included in the MobilityFromNRCommand message
options.C: When the UE is unable to comply with any part of the configuration in MobilityFromNRCommand
options.D: When a suitable E-UTRA cell cannot be selected

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.4.3.5, Mobility from NR failure
results.evidence: In clause 5.4.3.5 (Mobility from NR failure), the UE shall set the contents of VarRLF-Report and store it (replacing any previous report) only if AS security has been activated; that is, upon failing to establish the connection to the target RAT/system (e.g. due to T304 expiry, inability to comply with the MobilityFromNRCommand configuration, or a protocol error in the inter-RAT information), the UE stores the handover failure information in VarRLF-Report, setting connectionFailureType to 'hof' and previousPCellId etc., provided that AS security had already been activated when the failure occurred; if AS security had not been activated, the UE does not store the VarRLF-Report.

results.question: What specific action is required when the UE receives an SRS release request from lower layers?

options.A: Release PUCCH-CSI-Resources for the primary bandwidth part only
options.B: Release all SchedulingRequestResourceConfig instances across all serving cells
options.C: Release SRS-Resource instances configured in SRS-Config for all bandwidth parts of the indicated serving cell
options.D: Clear both PUCCH and SRS configurations for the indicated cell

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.12, UE actions upon PUCCH/SRS release request
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> release the SRS configuration identified by the srs-ResourceSetId contained in the SRS release request received from lower layers.

results.question: What does Event S2 indicate about the serving cell's condition?

options.A: The serving cell signal has improved above a threshold
options.B: The serving cell signal has degraded below a threshold
options.C: The serving cell has become the strongest among all detected cells
options.D: The serving cell signal is within acceptable hysteresis margins

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.10.4.3, Event S2 (Serving becomes worse than threshold)
results.evidence: Event S2 (Serving cell becomes worse than absolute threshold): entering condition: SS-RSRP of the serving cell is worse than threshold2, i.e. Ms - Hys < Thresh; leaving condition: SS-RSRP of the serving cell is better than threshold2, i.e. Ms - Hys > Thresh. Ms is expressed in dBm. Event S2 is used to indicate that the quality of the serving cell is below a certain absolute threshold, which can be used to trigger measurements or reporting for mobility purposes, such as triggering RRC connection re-establishment or cell reselection preparation, particularly relevant in scenarios involving measurement configuration for autonomous cell selection or serving cell quality monitoring for out-of-coverage detection.

results.question: When a UE releases a broadcast MRB for MBS broadcast service, how does it inform upper layers about this release?

options.A: By indicating the corresponding QoS flow ID
options.B: By indicating the corresponding radio bearer ID
options.C: By indicating the corresponding TMGI
options.D: By indicating the corresponding session ID

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.3.4, Broadcast MRB release
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> release the broadcast MRB used for the MBS broadcast service; 1> indicate the release of the broadcast MRB to upper layers.

results.question: Which configuration is released specifically upon receiving a positioning SRS configuration for RRC_INACTIVE release request?

options.A: All CSI-ReportConfig resources associated with the serving cell
options.B: The configured srs-PosRRC-InactiveConfig
options.C: SRS-Resource instances in the active bandwidth part only
options.D: PUCCH-Config for all bandwidth parts

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.12, UE actions upon PUCCH/SRS release request
results.evidence: Upon receiving a request to release RRC connection with positioning SRS configuration for RRC_INACTIVE, the UE shall release the sl-L2RelayUE-Config, if configured.

results.question: When removing a measId as specified in TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.2.2, what does the UE do with the associated information (e.g., timeToTrigger) for that measId?

options.A: It preserves the information for potential future reconfiguration of the same measId.
options.B: It reports the information to the network before removal.
options.C: It resets the associated information.
options.D: It transfers the information to a different, active measId.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.2, Measurement identity removal
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> remove the measId from the measIdList within VarMeasConfig; 1> remove all measurement reporting entries for this measId from the VarMeasReportList, if included; 1> if the removed measId concerns a measId included in measIdList within VarMeasConfig for which the associated reportConfig has a reportType set to reportCGI: remove all information associated with the measId (e.g. the entry within VarMeasReportList for this measId if included and the associated timers if running); 1> remove all associated information (e.g. time to trigger, cellsTriggeredList) that were used for evaluating triggering condition of this measId.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.6.3, what value should the UE set for measurementIndication in a LocationMeasurementIndication message when the procedure is initiated to indicate the start of positioning measurement towards NR?

options.A: nr-PRS-Measurement
options.B: eutra-RSTD

options.D: release

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.6.3, Actions related to transmission of LocationMeasurementIndication message
results.evidence: The UE shall set the measurementIndication as follows: 1> if the procedure is initiated to indicate the start of a positioning measurement occasion in NR: 2> set the measurementIndication to nr-Start;

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.5.13.4, when evaluating conditional reconfiguration, how does the UE identify an applicable cell when the condRRCReconfig includes masterCellGroup with reconfigurationWithSync?

options.A: The UE considers the cell with the same SSB frequency as indicated in ServingCellConfigCommon.

results.question: Upon receiving a PUCCH release request from lower layers, which of the following actions must the UE perform for all bandwidth parts of the indicated serving cell?

options.D: Deactivate all bandwidth parts and clear associated PUCCH configurations

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.12, UE actions upon PUCCH/SRS release request
results.evidence: Upon receiving a PUCCH release request from lower layers, the UE shall: 1> release the pucch-Config for all the bandwidth parts of the indicated serving cell, if configured.

results.question: When processing measId removal as per TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.2.2, which of the following timers does the UE explicitly stop if running for the measId being removed?

options.A: Timer T310 only
options.B: Timer T321 or Timer T322 only
options.C: The periodical reporting timer, Timer T321, or Timer T322
options.D: Timer T300 and Timer T301

results.question: In the context of TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.6.3, which condition leads the UE to set the measurementIndication to 'eutra-RSTD' in the LocationMeasurementIndication message?

options.A: When initiating the procedure to indicate the start of location related measurements for positioning measurement towards NR.
options.B: When initiating the procedure to indicate the start of location related measurements for RSTD measurements towards E-UTRA.
options.C: When initiating the procedure to indicate the start of subframe and slot timing detection towards E-UTRA.
options.D: When initiating the procedure to indicate the stop of location related measurements.

results.question: When a UE initiates a procedure to indicate the stop of subframe and slot timing detection towards E-UTRA, what value must it set for the measurementIndication field in the LocationMeasurementIndication message?

options.A: eutra-FineTimingDetection
options.B: eutra-RSTD

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.1.1, General
results.evidence: According to TS 38.331 clause 5.8.9.1.1, a UE initiates the sidelink RRC reconfiguration procedure over an established PC5-RRC connection in the following cases: 1) to establish, modify or release one or more sidelink radio bearers (SLRBs) for the corresponding unicast link; 2) to configure, modify or release sidelink DRX parameters for the unicast connection; 3) to configure or reconfigure sidelink measurement and measurement reporting for the peer UE; 4) to transfer NR sidelink UE information (e.g., UE capability, SLRB configuration) to the peer UE; and 5) upon change of configuration parameters affecting the PC5-RRC connection (e.g., due to change of the associated Uu RRC configuration such as SIB12 update or the UE moving between in-coverage/out-of-coverage). results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2, System information
results.evidence: The system information is divided into the MasterInformationBlock (MIB) and a number of SystemInformationBlocks (SIBs). The MIB is always transmitted on the BCCH logical channel mapped to BCH, with a periodicity of 80 ms and repetitions made within 80 ms, and is scheduled statically. SIBs other than SIB1 are carried in SystemInformationBlockType1 (SIB1), which is transmitted on the BCCH mapped to DL-SHCH... All the SIBs other than SIB1 are only broadcast when configured by the network, and may additionally be provided via dedicated signalling. The network may configure indication that a SIB has changed via SI change notification. Furthermore, only SIB1 has a fixed content and periodicity; the other SIBs are broadcast in SI messages, which are transmitted within periodically occurring time domain windows (SI-windows). Each SI message is associated with a SI-window and the SI-windows of different SI messages do not overlap.

results.question: According to 3GPP TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.4.3, what is the primary purpose of Event A2?

options.A: To trigger measurement reporting when the serving cell becomes better than a threshold
options.B: To trigger measurement reporting when the serving cell becomes worse than a threshold
options.C: To trigger measurement reporting when a neighboring cell becomes better than the serving cell
options.D: To trigger measurement reporting when a neighboring cell becomes worse than a threshold

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.3, Event A2 (Serving becomes worse than threshold)
results.evidence: Event A2 (Serving becomes worse than threshold): The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when Mn + Ofn + Ocn – Hys < Thresh, and shall consider the leaving condition to be satisfied when Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys > Thresh, where Mn is the measurement result of the serving cell, not taking into account any offsets. Event A2 is primarily used to trigger measurement reporting when the serving cell quality degrades below an absolute threshold, which is commonly used to initiate actions such as triggering inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurements, initiating handover procedures to a better cell, or triggering re-establishment/mobility procedures when the serving cell signal quality becomes worse than an acceptable level.

results.question: For a UE in coverage and configured to monitor NR sidelink discovery, if the chosen cell provides SIB12 and SIB12 contains sl-RxPool for NR sidelink but NOT sl-DiscRxPool, what action does TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.13.2 specify?

results.evidence: If SIB12 is provided by the chosen cell and includes sl-RxPool but not sl-DiscRxPool, the UE shall use the sl-RxPool included in SIB12 for monitoring NR sidelink discovery.

results.question: A UE is configured for NR sidelink discovery monitoring via RRCReconfiguration with reconfigurationWithSync (handover). results.evidence: If sl-DiscRxPool is configured in sldiscConfig within the RRCReconfiguration message received for handover (i.e. with reconfigurationWithSync) and sl-RxPool is also configured for NR sidelink discovery reception, the UE shall configure the lower layers to use sl-DiscRxPool for NR sidelink discovery monitoring.

results.question: What type of measurement event is Event I1 in 3GPP TS 38.331?

results.evidence: Event I1: Interruption of the serving cell(s) or the entity does not have a valid measurement result of the serving cell(s). Event I1 is defined as a measurement event related to inter-RAT/inter-system measurements where the UE reports based on a configured measurement identity when the entity does not have valid measurement results for the serving cell(s), used in the context of measurement reporting configuration for CondEvent/Idle or Inactive related measurements. Specifically, Event I1 (Interruption) is used for conditional handover or measurement gap related scenarios, defined as: the measured quality of an inter-system/inter-RAT cell becomes better than a threshold, applicable in the context of MeasObjectId associated with EUTRA or NR, used mainly for mobility to a different RAT or for connected mode measurement configuration under reportConfigInterRAT/reportConfigNR structures in RRCReconfiguration.

If the sl-ReportConfigId is not part of the current UE configuration (i.e. no matching entry exists in sl-ReportConfigList), the UE ignores that sl-ReportConfigId (i.e. no action is taken for that particular identity, and no failure is triggered due to this condition).

results.question: Which of the following best describes the 'offset' component in Event A3?

options.A: A fixed value defined by network standards
options.B: A configurable parameter applied to the comparison
options.C: The difference between two neighbour cells
options.D: The hysteresis value for event triggering

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.4, Event A3 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell)
results.evidence: a3-Offset: This field is used in Event A3 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell). The offset value used in the event formula is contained in this field, expressed as a threshold... The offset is used to introduce hysteresis-like margin so that the neighbour cell measurement (Mn) must exceed the serving cell measurement (Mp) by more than this offset (after applying Ofn, Ocn, Ofp, Ocp and Hys) before the entering condition Inequality A3-1 is satisfied, and must fall below it by more than the offset before the leaving condition Inequality A3-2 is satisfied.

results.question: What measurement relationship does Event A3 evaluate?

options.A: Comparison between two neighbour cells
options.B: Comparison between neighbour cell and serving cell with an offset
options.C: Absolute measurement of the serving cell
options.D: Absolute measurement of a neighbour cell

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.4, Event A3 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell)
results.evidence: Event A3 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell): Mn + Ofn + Ocn – Hys > Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off, where Mn is the measurement result of the neighbouring cell, not taking into account any offsets. Mp is the measurement result of the PCell/PSCell, not taking into account any offsets. Ofn is the frequency specific offset of the frequency of the neighbour cell. Ofp is the frequency specific offset of the primary frequency (i.e. the frequency of the PCell/PSCell). Ocn is the cell specific offset of the neighbour cell. Ocp is the cell specific offset of the PCell/PSCell. Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event. Off is the offset parameter for this event.

options.D: When configured with nr-SecondaryCellGroupConfig according to TS 36.331 and connected to 5GC

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.1.3, Requirements for UE in MR-DC
results.evidence: The UE considers itself to be in NE-DC when it is connected to an ng-eNB acting as the master node and an en-gNB acting as the secondary node, i.e., when configured with an NR SCG while connected to E-UTRA/5GC (MN terminates E-UTRA and SN terminates NR).

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.1.2, what triggers the network to initiate the DL information transfer procedure?

options.A: When the UE requests system information
options.B: When there is a need to transfer NAS dedicated information or F1-C related information
options.C: When performing a handover procedure
options.D: When establishing an RRC connection

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.1.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The network initiates the DL information transfer procedure to a UE in RRC_CONNECTED whenever it needs to transfer NAS or non-3GPP dedicated information to the UE, by sending the DLInformationTransfer message.

results.question: In the context of Event X2, what does the 'threshold' refer to?

options.A: A pre-configured absolute value for signal quality
options.B: A pre-configured value relative to the best neighboring relay UE
options.C: A network-signaled value that the serving relay UE's measurement must fall below
options.D: A UE-derived value based on historical signal quality averages

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.18, Event X2 (Serving L2 U2N Relay UE becomes worse than threshold)
results.evidence: The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition X2-1 is fulfilled and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition X2-2 is fulfilled, where: Inequality X2-1 (Entering condition): Ml – Hys < Thresh; Inequality X2-2 (Leaving condition): Ml + Hys > Thresh; The variable Thresh in the formula is expressed in dB. Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. thresholdCSI-RS-cellSFTD for event X2, or in general the threshold field configured within the reportConfig associated with the measId for this event), and Ml is the measurement result of the serving cell, not taking into account any offsets.

results.question: What must be true about both UEs involved in sidelink unicast communication for the RX UE to potentially send sidelink DRX assistance information?

options.A: Both UEs must be in RRC_CONNECTED state
options.B: Both UEs must be served by the same gNB
options.C: Both UEs must be capable of sidelink DRX
options.D: Both UEs must support carrier aggregation

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.6.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The RX UE may send sidelink DRX assistance information to its peer UE if both UEs support sidelink DRX and sidelink DRX is configured/used for the unicast connection between them.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.9.6.2, under what condition may an RX UE send sidelink DRX assistance information to its peer TX UE for unicast communication?

options.A: Only when the RX UE first establishes the sidelink connection
options.B: When the information has not been sent previously OR when previously transmitted information has changed
options.C: Only when explicitly requested by the peer TX UE
options.D: Whenever the RX UE enters RRC_CONNECTED state

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.6.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The RX UE may send SL DRX assistance information to a peer TX UE for unicast if it is configured to do so by upper layers (e.g., due to a request from the TX UE or application layer indication), and the RX UE includes this information in a PC5-RRC message (e.g., RRCReconfigurationSidelink or MeasurementReportSidelink) sent to the TX UE, in accordance with TS 24.587.

results.question: When a UE receives a ConditionalReconfiguration IE containing condReconfigToRemoveList, what action must it perform?

options.A: Initiate conditional reconfiguration addition procedure
options.B: Perform conditional reconfiguration removal procedure
options.C: Evaluate execution conditions for all candidate cells
options.D: Apply the conditional reconfiguration immediately

results.evidence: The UE shall perform the conditional reconfiguration removal as follows: 1> for each condReconfigId value included in the condReconfigToRemoveList that is part of the current UE configuration: 2> remove the entry with the matching condReconfigId from the VarConditionalReconfig, if any.

results.question: According to the initiation steps in clause 5.3.13.2, what does the UE do immediately upon determining that conditions for initiating SDT are fulfilled?

options.A: It releases successHO-Config from the UE Inactive AS context

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.13.2, Initiation
results.evidence: Upon initiation of the procedure, the UE shall: 1> if conditions for SDT are fulfilled as specified in clause 5.3.13.1a: 2> select and initiate the random-access procedure in accordance with the applicable random-access resource selection procedure or applicable configured grant configuration for SDT as specified in TS 38.321.

results.question: What information source does the UE use to determine if an MBS session is ongoing or about to start, as specified in TS 38.331 Clause 5.9.4.3?

options.A: The MCCH indication on the serving cell
options.B: The start and stop time indicated in the User Service Description (USD)
options.C: The MBS FSAIs included in SIB21
options.D: The UE's current serving frequency configuration

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.3, MBS frequencies of interest determination
results.evidence: The UE uses the MBS session information broadcast in the system information (specifically the information contained in SIB20/MBS-related system information, such as MBS neighbouring cell information and MBS session information) to determine if an MBS session identified by a TMGI is ongoing or about to start.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.9.4.3, which condition must be met for a UE to consider a frequency as part of the MBS frequencies of interest?

options.A: The UE must be currently receiving the MBS session via a broadcast MRB on that frequency.

options.C: At least one MBS session the UE is receiving or interested to receive via a broadcast MRB is ongoing or about to start.
options.D: The UE must verify that the session is indicated on MCCH for the concerned frequency.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.3, MBS frequencies of interest determination
results.evidence: The UE shall consider a frequency as one of the MBS frequencies of interest if the UE is interested to receive an ongoing or a future MBS broadcast service, indicated by upper layers via the MBS interest indication, on that frequency, i.e. the frequency provides or would provide access to the concerned MBS broadcast service(s), the frequency is included in the SIB providing MBS broadcast service configuration, and the UE would camp on that frequency according to the cell reselection rules were it in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE.

results.question: When evaluating UE capability for simultaneous reception of broadcast MRBs on MBS frequencies of interest, what does the UE NOT take into account according to TS 38.331 Clause 5.9.4.3?

options.A: The MBS frequencies it is interested to receive
options.B: The supportedBandCombination included in UE-NR-Capability
options.C: The serving frequencies that it is currently configured with
options.D: The MBS FSAIs indicated in the USD for the session

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.3, MBS frequencies of interest determination
results.evidence: The UE does not take into account other MRBs configured/being received via multicast MRBs, other RRC configuration in relation to signalling or unicast bearers, or capabilities related to unicast (e.g. bandwidth combination sets), when evaluating its capability to receive broadcast MRBs simultaneously on MBS frequency(ies) of interest.

results.question: When moving from NR to E-UTRA, what are the possible core networks that the E-UTRA can be connected to, as per TS 38.331 Clause 5.4.1?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.4.1, Introduction
results.evidence: The E-UTRA the UE moves to can be connected to Evolved Packet Core (EPC) or 5GC.

results.question: In TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.3.5, when the UE provides random access problem indication from SCG MAC and the random access procedure was initiated for beam failure recovery, what failureType value is set?

options.D: rlc-MaxNumRetx

results.evidence: Upon receiving random access problem indication from SCG MAC, or upon indication from SCG RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached, or upon consistent uplink LBT failure indication from SCG MAC while T304 is not running, the UE shall: 1> initiate the failure information procedure as specified in 5.7.5 to report SCG radio link failure, if the connection to the SCG is considered failed, i.e. if one of the following conditions is met: 2> set the failureType to beamFailureRecoverySCG upon random access problem indication from SCG MAC and the random access procedure was initiated for beam failure recovery, as specified in TS 38.321 [3].

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.3.5, what failureType value does the UE set when it initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformation message due to T310 expiry?

options.C: synchReconfigFailureSCG

results.question: What action does the UE take upon receiving a ConditionalReconfiguration IE containing condReconfigToAddModList?

options.A: Remove all existing conditional reconfigurations
options.B: Ignore the IE if conditions are not yet met
options.C: Perform conditional reconfiguration addition/modification
options.D: Immediately execute handover to the first candidate cell

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.13.1, General
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> for each condReconfigId value included in the received condReconfigToAddModList that is not part of the current UE configuration: 2> if the received CondReconfigToAddMod contains condRRCReconfig that includes the field nonCriticalExtension or in case of the RRCReconfiguration message within condRRCReconfig containing a masterCellGroup or secondaryCellGroup with fullConfig: 3> perform the actions upon reception of RRCReconfiguration as specified accordingly, considering it as part of the conditional reconfiguration; 2> store the condRRCReconfig within the VarConditionalReconfig associated to this condReconfigId; 2> store the condExecutionCond associated to this condReconfigId; 1> for each condReconfigId value included in the received condReconfigToAddModList that is part of the current UE configuration: 2> replace the condRRCReconfig for this condReconfigId with the value received for condRRCReconfig, if received; 2> replace the condExecutionCond for this condReconfigId with the value received for condExecutionCond, if received.

results.question: What type of mobility control is specified for the inter-RAT scenarios described in TS 38.331 Clause 5.4.1 Introduction?

options.A: UE autonomous mobility
options.B: Network controlled mobility
options.C: UE assisted mobility
options.D: Open loop mobility

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.4.1, Introduction
results.evidence: For inter-RAT mobility, the network initiates the handover procedure by means of the RRCReconfiguration message including the mobilityControlInfo, similar to intra-NR handover; network controlled mobility (network-controlled handover) applies also to inter-RAT scenarios, i.e. handover to/from E-UTRA (including handover to/from EPC), rather than UE-based cell reselection.

results.question: Which timer, if running, is NOT explicitly listed to be stopped by the UE upon reception of the RRCResume message?

results.question: What action does the UE take when sl-MeasConfig includes sl-QuantityConfig in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink, as specified in TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.10.2.1?

options.A: Perform sidelink measurement object addition/modification
options.B: Perform sidelink reporting configuration removal
options.C: Perform sidelink quantity configuration
options.D: Perform sidelink measurement identity addition/modification

results.question: Based on TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.10.2.1, which list in sl-MeasConfig triggers the sidelink measurement identity removal procedure?

options.A: sl-MeasIdToRemoveList
options.B: sl-MeasObjectToRemoveList
options.C: sl-ReportConfigToRemoveList

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.10.2.1, what procedure shall the UE perform if the received sl-MeasConfig includes the sl-MeasObjectToRemoveList in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink?

options.A: Sidelink measurement identity removal procedure
options.B: Sidelink measurement object removal procedure
options.C: Sidelink reporting configuration removal procedure
options.D: Sidelink quantity configuration procedure
