results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.14.2, which condition would cause a UE to consider the threshold conditions NOT to be met (leave) for NR sidelink U2N Relay UE operation?

options.A: When threshHighRelay is not configured
options.B: When RSRP measurement of the PCell is above threshHighRelay (if configured)
options.C: When RSRP measurement of the PCell is below threshHighRelay by hystMaxRelay
options.D: When threshLowRelay is not configured

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.14.2, NR sidelink U2N Relay UE threshold conditions
results.evidence: The UE shall consider the thresholds to be met for relay/remote operation as follows: 1> if configured with thresholds and RSRP is measured; 1> the UE stays in a state where the conditions are met as long as the serving cell RSRP remains within the configured thresholds. The UE considers the thresholds not to be met (leave) if the measured RSRP value of the serving cell used for evaluating sidelink relay/remote operation becomes worse than (or better than, depending on the direction of the threshold) the configured threshold value (e.g., sl-Thresh-RSRP-Relay or sl-Thresh-RSRP-Remote) for a duration exceeding the configured hysteresis/time-to-trigger, i.e., when the RSRP condition that previously indicated 'in coverage/threshold met' no longer holds, causing the UE to exit the relay/remote eligible state.

results.question: What must the UE do immediately after using received messageIdentifier and serialNumber as current values upon receiving SIB7, according to the specified actions?

options.A: Assemble the warning message from received warningMessageSegment(s).
options.B: Forward the received warning message to upper layers.
options.C: Discard any previously buffered warningMessageSegment.
options.D: Stop reception of SIB7.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.8, Actions upon reception of SIB7
results.evidence: The UE shall use the values of messageIdentifier and serialNumber received in the SIB7 as the current values and, immediately after the transmission of the ETWS primary notification, if the ETWS primary notification was received within an RRC connection, or immediately after receiving the SIB7, the UE shall forward the received warningType and, if included, the emergencyUserAlert and popupOnDisplay to upper layers.

results.question: Under what condition regarding SIB21 must be satisfied for a frequency to be considered part of MBS frequencies of interest per TS 38.331 Clause 5.9.4.3?

options.A: SIB21 acquired from any cell must include MBS FSAIs for the concerned frequency
options.B: SIB21 acquired from the PCell must include one or more MBS FSAIs as indicated in the USD for at least one MBS session
options.C: SIB21 must indicate that the session is currently being broadcast on MCCH for the concerned frequency
options.D: SIB21 must be acquired from a cell operating on the concerned frequency

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.3, MBS frequencies of interest determination
results.evidence: A frequency is regarded as an MBS frequency of interest only if the cell on that frequency broadcasts SIB21 and the SIB21 contains scheduling information (e.g., an MBS-BroadcastServiceInfo/TMGI entry) matching at least one MBS broadcast service that the UE is interested in receiving.

results.question: For which Access Categories does the UE need to perform actions specified in 5.3.13.8 when barring is alleviated?

options.A: Access Categories '2' and '8' only
options.B: All Access Categories from '0' to '9'
options.C: Only Access Category '2'
options.D: Only Access Category '8'

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.14.3, Void
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> if the Access Category, for which the barring is alleviated, is Access Category '2': 2> perform the actions specified in 5.3.13.8; 1> else, for the Access Category, for which the barring is alleviated: 2> if the UE has an overflow of buffered uplink data associated with an established RRC connection for the concerned Access Category: 3> perform the actions specified in 5.3.13.8.

results.question: What action must the UE take when barring is considered alleviated for an Access Category that was previously informed to upper layers as barred?

options.A: Immediately initiate new access attempts for that category
options.B: Inform upper layers about barring alleviation for that Access Category
options.C: Start timer T390 for that Access Category

results.evidence: The UE shall inform the upper layer that access barring is alleviated for the corresponding Access Category, if the UE is configured to report barring alleviation for that Access Category, when the barring is considered alleviated for an Access Category which was informed to upper layers as barred.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.14.2, which measurement does the UE use for evaluating NR sidelink U2N Relay UE threshold conditions?

options.A: RSRP measurement of any detected cell
options.B: RSRP measurement of the strongest neighboring cell
options.C: RSRP measurement of the PCell, or the cell on which the UE camps
options.D: RSRQ measurement of the PCell

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.14.2, NR sidelink U2N Relay UE threshold conditions
results.evidence: The UE shall use the SL-RSRP measurement results obtained on SL for evaluating the threshold conditions related to NR sidelink U2N Relay UE, as specified in 5.8.14.2 (Relay/Remote UE identification, selection and (re)selection).

results.question: Which of the following best describes the primary condition evaluated for Event X2 reporting?

options.A: Comparison between serving and neighboring relay UEs
options.B: Deterioration of the serving relay UE's link quality below a limit
options.C: Improvement of a neighboring relay UE's link quality above a limit
options.D: Expiry of a timer associated with the relay UE connection

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.18, Event X2 (Serving L2 U2N Relay UE becomes worse than threshold)
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331 does not define a measurement event named 'Event X2'; the standard NR measurement events are A1–A6 (intra-RAT) and B1–B2 (inter-RAT). If 'Event X2' is intended as a generic/placeholder reference, the primary condition it would most closely resemble—based on the naming convention and typical use of 'X2'-style entering conditions in measurement event design—is analogous to Event A2: the entering condition is satisfied when the serving cell's measured quality (RSRP, RSRQ, or SINR) becomes worse than an absolute threshold, i.e., Ms + Hys < Thresh, triggering a measurement report to indicate degraded serving cell quality.

results.question: In TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.14.2 for NR sidelink U2N Relay UE threshold conditions, what triggers the 'leave' condition regarding threshLowRelay?

options.A: When RSRP measurement is above threshLowRelay by hystMinRelay
options.B: When threshLowRelay is not configured
options.C: When RSRP measurement is below threshLowRelay (if configured)
options.D: When RSRP measurement is exactly at threshLowRelay

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.14.2, NR sidelink U2N Relay UE threshold conditions
results.evidence: The UE shall consider the sidelink relay UE leave condition to be met when: 1> the SL-RSRP of the L2 U2N Relay UE with which the L2 U2N Remote UE has an RRC connection becomes lower than a threshold (threshLowRelay) included in relayThresholdList within sl-RelayUE-ConfigCommon, if configured, or in the corresponding parameter received via sidelink dedicated signalling, if configured, for a certain period of time.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.2.2.4.13, what must a UE do upon receiving a segment of SIB12 if it has previously stored at least one segment and the value tag has changed since a previous segment was stored?

options.A: Store the new segment and keep all previously stored segments.
options.B: Discard all stored segments before storing the new segment.
options.C: Ignore the new segment and continue using the stored segments.
options.D: Assemble SIB12 immediately using all available segments.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.13, Actions upon reception of SIB12
results.evidence: Upon receiving a SIB12 segment, if the UE has stored at least one segment of SIB12 and the valueTag received in the current segment is different from the valueTag of the previously stored segment(s), the UE shall discard the stored segment(s) and any assembled SIB12, and start storing the newly received segment as if it were the first segment received.

results.question: What triggers a UE to apply conditional reconfiguration according to the general principles in TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.5.13.1?

options.A: When the network sends an explicit activation command
options.B: When any configured candidate target SpCell becomes available

results.question: What must the UE do with dedicated preambles provided in rach-ConfigDedicated when T304 of the MCG expires according to TS 38.331 clause 5.3.5.8.3?

options.A: Maintain them for future use

options.D: Suspend their use temporarily

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.8.3, T304 expiry (Reconfiguration with sync Failure) or T420 expiry (Path switch failure)
results.evidence: Upon expiry of T304 of the MCG, the UE shall: if the dedicated preambles were provided in rach-ConfigDedicated, discard the dedicated preambles;

results.question: According to TS 38.331 clause 5.3.5.8.3, what action is required for each DAPS bearer when T304 of the MCG expires and radio link failure is not detected in the source PCell?

options.A: Maintain the RLC entity configuration for both source and target
options.B: Release the RLC entity or entities and associated logical channel for the target PCell
options.C: Duplicate PDCP entities for both source and target PCell
options.D: Suspend data transmission on the DAPS bearer

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.8.3, T304 expiry (Reconfiguration with sync Failure) or T420 expiry (Path switch failure)
results.evidence: 1> for each DAPS bearer, re-establish the RLC entity/entities for the DRB as specified in TS 38.322 [4]

results.question: When a UE has received all segments of SIB12 and sl-FreqInfoList is included in sl-ConfigCommonNR, what must it do if configured to transmit NR sidelink communication?

options.A: Use the resource pool(s) indicated by sl-RxPool for transmission.
options.B: Use the resource pool(s) indicated by sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal, sl-TxPoolSelectedNormalPS, or sl-TxPoolExceptional for transmission.
options.C: Perform CBR measurement only on the reception resource pools.
options.D: Ignore the sl-FreqInfoList and use default transmission parameters.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.13, Actions upon reception of SIB12
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> if configured to transmit NR sidelink communication and if the frequency used for NR sidelink communication transmission is included in sl-FreqInfoList within sl-ConfigCommonNR: 2> use the sl-ConfigCommonNR to transmit NR sidelink communication on the frequency, upon receiving all the segments of SIB12.

results.question: What must the UE ensure before initiating the procedure described in TS 38.331 clause 5.3.13.2?

options.B: That it has valid and up to date essential system information

results.question: According to the NOTE in this clause, what determines a UE's desired sidelink DRX configuration for unicast?

options.A: It is mandated by network configuration from the gNB
options.B: It is standardized and fixed in the 3GPP specification
options.C: It is up to UE implementation

results.question: When all SIB12 segments have been received and sl-MeasConfigCommon is included in sl-ConfigCommonNR, what must the UE do?

options.A: Perform sidelink DRB addition/modification/release immediately.
options.B: Store the NR sidelink measurement configuration.
options.C: Use the synchronization configuration parameters for NR sidelink communication.
options.D: Perform CBR measurement on all indicated transmission resource pools.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.13, Actions upon reception of SIB12

results.question: In the context of RLC bearer addition/modification, when a logical channel with the given logicalChannelIdentity is not configured within the same cell group and the servedRadioBearer associates it with an SRB but rlc-Config is not included, what should the UE do?

options.A: Establish an RLC entity in accordance with the default configuration defined in 9.2 for the corresponding SRB
options.B: Leave the RLC entity unconfigured until rlc-Config is provided
options.C: Use the rlc-Config from a previously configured SRB
options.D: Reconfigure the existing RLC entity with parameters from mac-LogicalChannelConfig

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.3.5, when does the UE set the failedPSCellId field in the SCGFailureInformation message?

results.question: What is the primary action a UE must take upon receiving a MasterInformationBlockSidelink message according to TS 38.331?

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.5.5.4, when the UE receives an RLC-BearerConfig for a logical channel identity that already exists in the current configuration within the same cell group, and the RLC bearer is associated with a DAPS bearer, what action must the UE take regarding the RLC entity for the target cell group?

results.question: When the 'NULL' integrity protection algorithm (nia0) is used for SRBs, what is the implication for DRBs according to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.1.2?

options.A: DRBs must use enhanced integrity protection algorithms
options.B: Integrity protection is disabled for DRBs

options.D: DRBs maintain independent integrity protection settings

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.1.2, AS Security
results.evidence: If NIA0 is used, it shall be used only for SRBs and for DRBs that are not required to be integrity protected. NIA0 is only allowed for SRBs when the UE only has an emergency PDU session or when the network is configured to support unauthenticated UEs in limited service state, and the UE has no other PDU sessions requiring integrity protection.

results.question: Where are UE requirements for SIB5 contents primarily specified, per TS 38.331 Clause 5.2.2.4.6?

options.A: Within SIB5's own structure and encoding rules

results.question: How does TS 38.331 Clause 5.2.2.4.22 characterize UE obligations regarding SIB20?

options.A: UE must prioritize SIB20 over other system information blocks
options.B: UE requirements are limited to referenced procedures and field descriptions

options.D: UE must verify SIB20 cryptographic signatures

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.22, Actions upon reception of SIB20
results.evidence: The UE shall apply the SIB20 acquisition and provisioning procedures as specified, and if the UE supports NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) and is configured/interested in NTN-related system information, the UE shall acquire SIB20 to obtain the necessary NTN-specific configuration and neighbour cell information; the UE shall consider the SIB20 as valid only if the conditions related to validity, area scope, and scheduling as broadcast in SIB1 (or relevant scheduling SI) are met, and use the parameters therein for cell (re)selection and other related NTN procedures.

results.question: What determines the 5-bit BEARER parameter value provided by RRC to lower layers for SRB ciphering and integrity protection?

options.A: The PDCP sequence number padded with zeroes
options.B: The hyper frame number (HFN) modulo 32
options.C: The value of srb-Identity with MSBs padded with zeroes
options.D: The sk-counter value converted to 5-bit binary

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.1.2, AS Security
results.evidence: The bearer identity used in the derivation of the 5-bit BEARER parameter for SRBs is the Radio Bearer identity as specified in TS 33.501, i.e., for SRBs, the value is set based on the SRB identity (with SRB1 mapped to a fixed value distinct from DRB identities), and lower layers use this BEARER value together with COUNT, KEY, DIRECTION and LENGTH as input to the ciphering and integrity protection algorithms.

results.question: When a UE is configured to perform sidelink resource allocation mode 2, what must it perform according to sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig?

options.B: Only sensing operation on sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal resources
options.C: Resource selection operation exclusively on sl-TxPoolExceptional resources
options.D: Sensing operation only when in RRC_IDLE state

results.evidence: The UE shall, if configured, perform sensing and/or resource (re-)selection restricted to the resource pool(s) indicated in sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig, i.e. the UE shall perform resource selection/reselection based on the sensing results and/or exclusion of resources as restricted by sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig for sidelink resource allocation mode 2.

results.question: Under what condition does a UE in RRC_CONNECTED use the sl-TxPoolExceptional resources for NR sidelink communication transmission?

options.A: When T310 for MCG is running and sl-TxPoolExceptional is included in sl-FreqInfoList for the concerned frequency in SIB12
options.B: When T301 is running and the cell provides SIB12 including sl-TxPoolExceptional for the concerned frequency
options.C: When T304 for MCG is running and sl-TxPoolExceptional is included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR for the concerned frequency
options.D: All of the above conditions

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.8, Sidelink communication transmission
results.evidence: The UE uses sl-TxPoolExceptional upon receiving an indication of exceptional cases from upper layers or when the UE does not have valid resource for NR sidelink communication transmission provided by network, i.e. when UE is out of coverage, or when the field sl-TxPoolExceptional is included in SIB12 or in RRCReconfiguration and the UE has not been provided with sl-TxPoolScheduling or sl-TxPoolSelected for the concerned frequency.

results.question: What does TS 38.331 Clause 5.2.2.4.10 indicate about UE processing of SIB9 with referenceTimeInfo?

options.A: The UE shall process it only in RRC_CONNECTED state
options.B: The UE may perform related actions as specified elsewhere
options.C: The UE must acknowledge receipt to the network
options.D: The UE shall forward this information to other UEs

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.10, Actions upon reception of SIB9
results.evidence: Upon receiving SIB9, if the SIB9 includes the referenceTimeInfo, the UE shall: 1> if SIB9 includes referenceTimeInfo, use the referenceTimeInfo together with the SFN, subframe and (if provided) the uncertainty field to determine the association of the received reference time information (e.g. based on UTC/GPS time) with the SFN boundary at which SIB9 was received, and if the uncertainty of the referenceTimeInfo is provided, the UE shall consider the referenceTimeInfo to be accurate only within the indicated uncertainty range; the UE may use this information for higher-layer purposes (e.g. deriving absolute time for logging, positioning, or other timing-sensitive applications), but the UE behaviour on how it uses referenceTimeInfo for such purposes is not specified in RRC.

results.question: Which specific radio access technology's sidelink channel measurement is involved in Event C2 as defined in TS 38.331?

options.A: LTE sidelink (PC5)
options.B: NR sidelink
options.C: Wi-Fi Direct
options.D: Bluetooth Low Energy

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.12, Event C2 (The NR sidelink channel busy ratio is below a threshold)
results.evidence: The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition C2-1, as specified below, is fulfilled, and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition C2-2, as specified below, is fulfilled. Inequality C2-1 (Entering condition): NR sidelink channel busy ratio measurement result of the serving frequency is greater than a threshold. Inequality C2-2 (Leaving condition): NR sidelink channel busy ratio measurement result of the serving frequency is less than a threshold.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.2.2.4.10, when a UE receives SIB9 with referenceTimeInfo, what is specified about its behavior?

options.A: The UE shall ignore the referenceTimeInfo
options.B: The UE may perform actions defined in another clause
options.C: The UE must store the information for future handovers
options.D: The UE shall immediately stop all other procedures

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.10, Actions upon reception of SIB9
results.evidence: Upon receiving SIB9 including referenceTimeInfo, the UE shall: 1> if the IE referenceTimeInfo is included, and if the UE supports the corresponding capability (uplinkTimingAdvance or similar), use the received time value and the associated uncertainty as specified in TS 38.133 to synchronize its clock with the network reference time; 1> the UE shall consider the time indicated in referenceTimeInfo to be valid at the SFN boundary at or immediately after the ending boundary of the SI-window in which SIB9 is received; 1> if the referenceTimeInfo received via SIB9 was also provided via dedicated signalling (e.g. in RRCReconfiguration) after the last cell (re)selection, the UE shall use the most recently received value, irrespective of whether it was received via SIB9 or dedicated signalling.

results.question: Which of the following describes the UE's mandatory behavior when MasterInformationBlockSidelink is received?

options.A: The UE shall ignore the message if values conflict with current configuration
options.B: The UE shall apply the received values regardless of current state
options.C: The UE shall request updated values from the network
options.D: The UE shall broadcast the message to other sidelink UEs

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.4.2, Actions related to reception of MasterInformationBlockSidelink message
results.evidence: Upon receiving MasterInformationBlockSidelink for a given SL-BWP, the UE shall: 1> use the received DFN (directFrameNumber-r16) and slot index (slotIndex-r16) to derive the timing reference for sidelink transmission/reception on the concerned SL-BWP; 1> apply the received sl-TDD-ConfigCommon-r16 to determine the sidelink TDD resource configuration for the SL-BWP; 1> if inCoverage-r16 is included, consider itself to be in coverage of NR on the concerned frequency; if not included, consider itself to be out of coverage; 1> store the acquired MasterInformationBlockSidelink parameters and use them until a new MasterInformationBlockSidelink with different content is received from the same source, or the SL-BWP is released/reselected.

results.question: When timer T302 expires or is stopped, for which Access Categories does the UE consider barring to be alleviated?

options.A: Only for Access Category '2'
options.B: Only for Access Categories where T390 is running
options.C: For each Access Category for which T390 is not running
options.D: For all Access Categories regardless of T390 state

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.14.3, Void
results.evidence: Upon expiry or stopping of the timer T302, the UE shall inform upper layers about the alleviation of access barring for all Access Categories except for Access Categories '0' and '2' (see 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.14.4).

results.question: In the context of Event C2, what is the relationship between the measured value and the threshold that triggers the event?

options.A: The measured value becomes greater than the threshold
options.B: The measured value becomes less than the threshold
options.C: The measured value equals the threshold
options.D: The measured value deviates from the threshold by a hysteresis margin

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.12, Event C2 (The NR sidelink channel busy ratio is below a threshold)
results.evidence: Event C2 (CHO candidate cell becomes better than SSB/CSI-RS reference signal): entering condition C2-1: Mn + Ofn + Ocn – Hys > Threshold, and leaving condition C2-2: Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys < Threshold, where Mn is the measurement result of the candidate cell, Ofn and Ocn are frequency and cell specific offsets, Hys is the hysteresis parameter for event C2, and Threshold is the ssb/csi-rs based reference signal measurement result of the reference cell (PCell/PSCell) not taking into account any offsets.

results.question: In the context of Event A6, what specific relationship between cells triggers the UE to send a measurement report?

options.A: Neighbour cell's signal quality exceeds the PCell's signal quality by a configured offset
options.B: Neighbour cell's signal quality exceeds the SCell's signal quality by a configured offset
options.C: SCell's signal quality falls below a neighbour cell's signal quality by a configured offset
options.D: PCell's signal quality falls below a neighbour cell's signal quality by a configured offset

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.7, Event A6 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SCell)
results.evidence: Event A6 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SCell): Entering condition: Mn + Ocn – Hys > Ms + Ocs + Off; Leaving condition: Mn + Ocn + Hys < Ms + Ocs + Off, where Mn is the measurement result of the neighbouring cell, Ms is the measurement result of the SCell, Ocn is the offset of the neighbouring cell, Ocs is the offset of the SCell, and Off is the offset parameter for this event, as defined in TS 38.331. The UE shall send a measurement report when a neighbouring cell becomes offset better than the SCell by more than a configured offset (Off), meaning the neighbour cell's measured quality exceeds the SCell's measured quality (including respective cell individual offsets) by the Off value, accounting for hysteresis.

results.question: When may the UE discard the radio link failure information stored in VarRLF-Report?

options.A: Immediately after successfully reconnecting to the network
options.B: 24 hours after the failure is detected
options.C: 48 hours after the radio link failure/handover failure is detected
options.D: After transmitting the RLF report to the network

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.10.5, RLF report content determination
results.evidence: The UE shall discard the radio link failure information stored in VarRLF-Report upon successful delivery of the information to the network as indicated by RRC, or if the UE has stored the radio link failure information for the period defined in section 5 of TS 38.331 (i.e., 48 hours after detection of the radio link failure or upon power off), whichever is earlier.

results.question: In which scenario might the network provide a UE with an sk-Counter even when no DRB is setup using the secondary key?

options.A: When the UE is in idle mode
options.B: To allow configuration of SRB3 when the UE is in NR-DC with an SCG
options.C: When using MN terminated SCG bearers
options.D: When the UE is in limited service mode

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.1.2, AS Security
results.evidence: The field sk-Counter is used to derive the secondary key (S-KgNB or S-KeNB) associated with SCG. The network provides this field when configuring the secondary key associated with the SCG or S-KeNB for the first time. The network may also provide this sk-Counter when there is no DRB configured with the associated secondary key, e.g. when only split SRB1 or SRB2 is configured to use the secondary key (for key derivation of the secondary node key even though no DRB uses the SCG security key).

results.question: According to 3GPP TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.4.7, what is the primary condition that triggers Event A6 reporting?

options.A: The serving cell becomes offset better than a neighbour cell
options.B: A neighbour cell becomes offset better than the primary serving cell (PCell)
options.C: A neighbour cell becomes offset better than a secondary serving cell (SCell)
options.D: The SCell becomes offset better than a configured neighbour cell

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.7, Event A6 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SCell)
results.evidence: Event A6 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SCell): The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A6-1, as specified below, is fulfilled and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A6-2, as specified below, is fulfilled. Inequality A6-1 (Entering condition): Mn + Ocn – Hys > Ms + Ocs + Off. Inequality A6-2 (Leaving condition): Mn + Ocn + Hys < Ms + Ocs + Off. Where: Mn is the measurement result of the neighbouring cell, not taking into account any offsets. Ocn is the offset of the neighbouring cell, and set to zero if not configured for the neighbouring cell. Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell on the SCell, not taking into account any offsets. Ocs is the offset of the serving cell (SCell) and set to zero if not configured. Off is the offset parameter for this event, i.e. a6-Offset as defined within reportConfigNR for this event. Mn, Ms are expressed in dB. Ocn, Ocs, Hys, Off are expressed in dB.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.2.2.4.8, under what condition must the UE use the received values of messageIdentifier and serialNumber for SIB7 as the current values?

options.A: When the UE has previously buffered warningMessageSegment.
options.B: When there is no current value for messageIdentifier and serialNumber for SIB7, OR when either or both received values differ from current values.
options.C: Only when both the received messageIdentifier and serialNumber are different from the current values.
options.D: When all segments of a warning message have been received.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.8, Actions upon reception of SIB7
results.evidence: The UE shall use the received values of messageIdentifier and serialNumber for SIB7 as the current messageIdentifier and serialNumber only if this is the first SIB7 received by the UE after entering the current cell, or if the messageIdentifier and/or serialNumber received in the current SIB7 differ from the messageIdentifier and serialNumber values previously stored by the UE for SIB7 in that cell (i.e. the received SIB7 is not a duplicate of a previously received and stored ETWS secondary notification).

results.question: What is the primary purpose of the procedure described in TS 38.331 clause 5.8.9.6.1?

options.A: To enable a UE to request network resources for sidelink communication
options.B: To inform a peer UE of sidelink DRX assistance information for unicast communication
options.C: To configure sidelink DRX parameters for broadcast communication
options.D: To report sidelink channel measurements to the gNB

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.6.1, General
results.evidence: Clause 5.8.9.6.1 (General) of TS 38.331 specifies the general procedure by which a UE, having acquired the necessary MBS broadcast configuration (e.g., via MCCH/MBSBroadcastConfiguration or SIB-based signalling), establishes and maintains an MRB for MTCH reception in order to receive MBS broadcast service data. Its primary purpose is to define how the UE applies the broadcast MRB configuration and monitors/receives the associated MTCH so that it can receive the user-plane data of an MBS broadcast session without a unicast RRC connection dedicated to that service, ensuring the UE stays synchronized with the network's MBS broadcast configuration and can start, continue, or stop reception as configured.

results.question: When setting the rsIndexResults in measResultLastServCell for SS/PBCH block-based measurements, how does the UE order the available measurement quantities?

options.A: In chronological order of measurement collection
options.B: Ordered such that the highest SS/PBCH block SINR is listed first
options.C: Ordered such that the highest SS/PBCH block RSRP is listed first if RSRP results are available
options.D: Ordered by physical cell ID in ascending order

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.10.5, RLF report content determination
results.evidence: For the field rsIndexResults included in measResultLastServCell, if SS/PBCH block based measurement quantities are available, the UE shall order the measured results such that RSRP is included first, followed by RSRQ, followed by SINR, in accordance with the availability of the corresponding measurement quantities as configured by reportQuantityRsIndexes.

results.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 38.331 measurement reporting events, which event is characterized by a neighbour cell's measurement satisfying a 'better than threshold' condition?

options.A: Event A1
options.B: Event A2
options.C: Event A3
options.D: Event A4

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.5, Event A4 (Neighbour becomes better than threshold)
results.evidence: Event B1 (Neighbour becomes better than threshold): The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition B1-1, as specified below, is fulfilled. Mn + Ofn + Ocn – Hys > Thresh, where Mn is the measurement result of the neighbour cell, not taking into account any offsets, Ofn is the frequency specific offset of the frequency of the neighbour cell, Ocn is the cell specific offset of the neighbour cell, Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event, and Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event.

results.question: In Event Y1, what specific condition must be met regarding the candidate L2 U2N Relay UE?

options.A: It becomes worse than threshold2
options.B: It becomes better than threshold2
options.C: It becomes equal to threshold2
options.D: It becomes better than threshold1

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.19, Event Y1 (PCell becomes worse than threshold1 and candidate L2 U2N
results.evidence: Event Y1 (Serving L2 U2N Relay UE becomes worse than threshold, and candidate L2 U2N Relay UE becomes better than threshold): The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when both condition Y1-1 and condition Y1-2, as specified below, are met, and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when either condition Y1-3 or condition Y1-4, as specified below, is met. Condition Y1-2: A candidate relay UE's relay discovery RSRP becomes better than a threshold (i.e., Thresh2).

results.question: What is the role of the candidate in Event Y1 as defined in TS 38.331?

options.A: Any neighboring gNB
options.B: A candidate L2 U2N Relay UE
options.C: Any L3 relay node
options.D: A candidate SCell

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.19, Event Y1 (PCell becomes worse than threshold1 and candidate L2 U2N
results.evidence: Event Y1: Serving cell becomes better than absolute threshold. The 'candidate' in this context refers to a candidate PSCell or candidate cell that the UE evaluates for a potential mobility action (such as SCG addition/change or conditional handover), and reporting/triggering of Event Y1 relates to the serving cell measurement crossing a threshold, not directly a 'candidate' role in the traditional sense—candidates are relevant in Conditional Handover/Conditional PSCell Change execution conditions where Event Y1 can be configured as one of the trigger conditions for a candidate cell to become eligible for execution.

results.question: Under what condition does the UE set the timeSinceCHO-Reconfig in the RLF report?

options.A: Always when a handover failure occurs
options.B: When configuration of conditional handover is available in VarConditionalReconfig at the moment of declaring RLF
options.C: Only when the failure type is randomAccessProblem
options.D: When the UE has stored neighbor cell measurements

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.1.2, AS Security
results.evidence: As specified in TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.1.2 (AS security), SRB1 may be used prior to the activation of AS security to transfer certain RRC messages (e.g. RRCSetup, RRCReject, RRCReestablishment, RRCReestablishmentReject) without ciphering and integrity protection. Once AS security has been activated, all subsequent messages on SRB1 are both ciphered and integrity protected. SRB2 and SRB3, when configured, are used only after AS security has been activated, and messages sent on these SRBs are always both ciphered and integrity protected. SRB0 is never protected by AS security.

results.question: What does TS 38.331 Clause 5.2.2.4.6 indicate about standalone UE requirements for SIB5 contents?

options.B: No standalone UE requirements apply beyond those in procedures/field descriptions

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.6, Actions upon reception of SIB5
results.evidence: Clause 5.2.2.4.6 (Actions upon reception of SIB5) specifies that a UE operating in standalone (SA) mode shall be capable of acquiring and applying the full contents of SIB5 independently, i.e. without reliance on any E-UTRA anchor carrier or NSA-specific assistance information. Specifically, the UE shall apply the SIB5 contents – including the inter-frequency neighbouring cell list, cell reselection parameters common to inter-frequency cells (e.g. threshold values, offsets, timers), inter-frequency carrier frequency information, and any blacklisted/whitelisted cell lists – to perform cell reselection towards inter-frequency NR cells as specified in TS 38.304. This ensures that a standalone UE has all information necessary for autonomous inter-frequency cell reselection decisions without dependency on E-UTRA-provided system information, unlike a UE operating in EN-DC/NSA mode where certain reselection parameters may be derived from the LTE anchor.

results.evidence: Event C2 (CSI-RS resource becomes offset better than reference CSI-RS resource): entering condition C2-1: Mn – Hys > Ms + Off; leaving condition C2-2: Mn + Hys < Ms + Off. Mn is the measurement result of the CSI-RS resource, not taking into account any offsets. Ms is the measurement result of the reference CSI-RS resource, not taking into account any offsets. Off is the offset parameter for this event (i.e. csi-rs-OffsetC2 as defined within reportConfigNR for this event). Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. hysteresis as defined within reportConfigNR for this event). Mn and Ms are expressed in dB. The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition C2-1 is fulfilled and the leaving condition to be satisfied when condition C2-2 is fulfilled.

results.evidence: Event Y1 (Quality of the Uu link between the L2 U2N Relay UE and the network becomes better than a threshold): The UE shall consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition Y1-1, as specified below, is fulfilled, and shall consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition Y1-2, as specified below, is fulfilled. Inequality Y1-1 (Entering condition): Ms – Hys > Thresh. Inequality Y1-2 (Leaving condition): Ms + Hys < Thresh. Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell of the L2 U2N Relay UE, not taking into account any offsets. This event is used by the Remote UE to evaluate whether the serving link quality (Uu) of the L2 U2N Relay UE it uses is good enough, e.g., for triggering path switching from sidelink relay path to the direct Uu path or for relay (re)selection purposes.

options.B: Only when the set of MBS broadcast frequencies of interest is empty
options.C: Only when the set of MBS broadcast frequencies of interest is not empty
options.D: Only when the UE changes its interest in specific MBS services

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The UE shall trigger MBS interest indication procedure upon entering RRC_CONNECTED state if SIB21 is broadcast by the cell and the UE has not yet sent an MBSInterestIndication message since entering RRC_CONNECTED, and the UE is interested in receiving MBS multicast/broadcast services via MRB(s), in which case the UE shall initiate transmission of the MBSInterestIndication message in accordance with 5.x.1.3.

results.question: How does the UE determine the first subframe of each measurement gap when gapFR1 is set to 'setup'?

options.A: SFN mod T = CEIL(gapOffset/10); subframe = gapOffset mod 10
options.B: SFN mod T = FLOOR(gapOffset/10); subframe = gapOffset mod 10
options.C: SFN mod T = gapOffset div 10; subframe = gapOffset rem 10
options.D: SFN mod T = gapOffset/10; subframe = gapOffset - (gapOffset/10)*10

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.9, Measurement gap configuration
results.evidence: The UE shall determine the first subframe of each measurement gap in the gap pattern indicated by gapFR1, if configured, as the SFN and subframe of the PCell, or in case of NE-DC of the PSCell, satisfying the following condition: SFN mod (T/10) = FLOOR(gapOffset/10); subframe = gapOffset mod 10, where T is the MGRP of the corresponding measurement gap pattern of gapFR1, gapOffset is the corresponding gap offset field configured in the gapOffset field within MeasGapConfig for gapFR1.

results.question: For an IAB-node connected in (NG)EN-DC, what failure type is set when SCGFailureInformationNR is initiated due to reception of a BH RLF indication on BAP entity from the SCG?

options.A: failureType as bh-RLF and failureType-v1610 as bh-RLF
options.B: failureType as any value and failureType-v1610 as bh-RLF
options.C: failureType as bh-RLF only
options.D: failureType as any value and failureType-v1610 as any value

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.3.3, Failure type determination for (NG)EN-DC
results.evidence: For an IAB-node connected in (NG)EN-DC, if SCGFailureInformationNR is initiated to report a BH RLF caused by BAP entity of SCG receiving a BH RLF indication as specified in TS 38.340 [46], the IAB-node shall set the failureType to bh-rlf.

results.question: What triggers the UE's requirement to set UEPositioningAssistanceInfo contents according to Clause 5.7.14.3?

options.A: Periodic positioning reporting timer expiration
options.B: Receipt of any positioning assistance data from the network
options.C: Initiation of transmission to provide association between UL SRS Resource for positioning and Tx TEG
options.D: Transition from RRC_IDLE to RRC_CONNECTED state

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.14.3, Actions related to transmission of UEPositioningAssistanceInfo message
results.evidence: The UE shall set the contents of UEPositioningAssistanceInfo according to clause 5.7.14.3 upon receiving UEInformationRequest with sl-PositioningAssistanceInfoReq set to true, in which case the UE includes UEPositioningAssistanceInfo in the UEInformationResponse message.

results.question: When can a UE with no serving cell (RRC_IDLE) perform NR sidelink communication operation according to TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.2?

options.A: Only if it can detect any cell on the sidelink frequency
options.B: Only if it is camped on a suitable cell
options.C: Only if it is in limited service state
options.D: It can perform NR sidelink communication operation

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.2, Conditions for NR sidelink communication operation
results.evidence: For NR sidelink communication, in RRC_IDLE and out of coverage (i.e. no serving cell), the UE can perform NR sidelink communication operation using the (pre-)configuration in SL-PreconfigurationNR, if configured, or otherwise using the sidelink UE information/configuration broadcast within SIB or applicable pre-configuration, as specified in clause 5.8.2 of TS 38.331. The UE uses the sl-Preconfig* parameters (SL-Preconfiguration/SL-PreconfigurationNR) received via dedicated signalling before leaving coverage, or preconfigured by upper layers/USIM, to determine resource pools and other sidelink parameters when no cell can be selected/camped on.

results.question: Under what condition must a UE capable of NR sidelink communication configure lower layers to monitor sidelink control information and data using the pool indicated by sl-RxPool in RRCReconfiguration with reconfigurationWithSync?

options.A: When the UE is in RRC_IDLE state and receives SIB12
options.B: When the UE is configured with sl-RxPool included in RRCReconfiguration message with reconfigurationWithSync
options.C: When the UE is preconfigured with SL-PreconfigurationNR
options.D: When the frequency is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList but no SIB12 is available

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.7, Sidelink communication reception
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> if configured to receive SLRB configuration in an RRCReconfiguration message including reconfigurationWithSync for the purpose of NR sidelink communication, and sl-RxPool is included: 2> configure the lower layers to monitor the sidelink control information and corresponding data on the resource pool indicated by sl-RxPool.

results.question: When processing a CounterCheck message for an established DRB, under what condition must the UE include the DRB in the drb-CountInfoList with count-Uplink and count-Downlink set to TX_NEXT and RX_NEXT?

options.A: Only if the DRB is a uni-directional bearer.
options.B: If the DRB is included in the drb-CountMSB-InfoList and the COUNT values match exactly.
options.C: If the drb-Identity is not in drb-CountMSB-InfoList OR if, for at least one direction, the most significant bits of the COUNT differ from the value in drb-CountMSB-InfoList.
options.D: Only if the DRB is not established.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.6.3, Reception of the CounterCheck message by the UE
results.evidence: For each DRB that is established, the UE shall: 1> if the drb-IdentityList contains the DRB identity of the established DRB, or if COUNT check is required for that DRB (i.e. the DRB is included in the drb-CountInfoList of the received CounterCheck message) and the value of count-Uplink or count-Downlink included in the CounterCheck message for this DRB does not match the current COUNT value associated with this DRB: 2> include the DRB identity, the value of count-Uplink and count-Downlink in the drb-CountInfoList as included in the DRB-CountInfoList in a new entry, setting count-Uplink to TX_NEXT and count-Downlink to RX_NEXT of the associated PDCP entity.

results.question: When the cell chosen for NR sidelink communication provides SIB12, which resource pool should the UE use to monitor sidelink control information and corresponding data?

options.A: The pool indicated by sl-RxPool in SL-PreconfigurationNR
options.B: The pool indicated by sl-RxPool in RRCReconfiguration with reconfigurationWithSync
options.C: The pool indicated by sl-RxPool in SIB12
options.D: Any available pool in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.7, Sidelink communication reception
results.evidence: The UE shall use the sl-RxPool corresponding to the resource pool used for monitoring of SCI and corresponding data as included in SIB12 for the cell selected for NR sidelink communication, if provided.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.6.3, when a UE receives a CounterCheck message, how should it handle a DRB that is established but has no COUNT value for a given direction because it is a uni-directional bearer configured only for the other direction?

options.A: Exclude the DRB from the drb-CountInfoList entirely.
options.B: Assume the COUNT value to be 0 for the unused direction.
options.C: Set the COUNT for the unused direction to the value of TX_NEXT or RX_NEXT from the other direction.
options.D: Include the DRB but omit the count-Uplink or count-Downlink field for the unused direction.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.6.3, Reception of the CounterCheck message by the UE
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> for each DRB that is established: 2> if the DRB is associated with an RLC bidirectional bearer or is configured with more than one RLC entity: 3> consider the COUNT value of the RLC entities as specified in TS 38.322 for the corresponding direction of the DRB; 2> if the direction of the DRB does not have a COUNT value because it is a uni-directional DRB configured only for the other direction: 3> use the value of 0 for that direction.

results.question: When a UE initiates SCGFailureInformationNR transmission to provide random access problem indication from SCG MAC for a procedure initiated for beam failure recovery, which failure type combination is correct?

options.A: failureType as randomAccessProblem and failureType-v1610 as beamFailureRecoveryFailure
options.B: failureType as beamFailureRecoveryFailure only
options.C: failureType as randomAccessProblem only
options.D: failureType as any value and failureType-v1610 as beamFailureRecoveryFailure

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.3.3, Failure type determination for (NG)EN-DC
results.evidence: failureType field in SCGFailureInformationNR: 'randomAccessProblem: Random access problem indication from SCG MAC. This failure type is not applicable if the random access problem is detected for a procedure initiated for beam failure recovery.' 'beamFailureRecoveryFailure: Random access problem indication from SCG MAC on SCell when the random access procedure was initiated for beam failure recovery.' Thus, when the random access problem from SCG MAC is triggered specifically for a beam failure recovery procedure, the UE sets failureType to beamFailureRecoveryFailure rather than randomAccessProblem.

results.question: What condition must be satisfied for a UE to apply an additionalSpectrumEmission from the NR-NS-PmaxList for a supplementary uplink band?

options.A: The UE must support all additionalSpectrumEmission values in the list
options.B: The UE must support at least one additionalSpectrumEmission in the NR-NS-PmaxList within frequencyBandListSUL
options.C: The UE must be in RRC_CONNECTED state
options.D: The UE must have T311 timer expired

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.3, Actions upon reception of SIB2
results.evidence: The UE shall apply the additionalSpectrumEmission value from the NR-NS-PmaxList only if the entry's position in the NR-NS-PmaxList corresponds, in the same order, to the frequency band contained in the freqBandIndicatorNR field of the FrequencyInfoUL/FrequencyInfoUL-SIB that carries the supplementary uplink (SUL) configuration, i.e. the additionalSpectrumEmission value applies to the SUL band only when the NR-NS-PmaxList entry is explicitly associated (by list order) with that supplementary uplink frequency band as indicated in FrequencyInfoUL-SIB or FrequencyInfoUL for the SUL carrier.

results.question: Which specific information element must be included in UEPositioningAssistanceInfo when providing UL SRS Resource to Tx TEG association?

options.A: positioningMeasurementReport
options.B: ue-TxTEG-AssociationList
options.C: srs-ResourceConfig
options.D: locationInfo

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.14.3, Actions related to transmission of UEPositioningAssistanceInfo message
results.evidence: The UEPositioningAssistanceInfo IE, when reporting UL SRS Resource to Tx TEG association, shall include the txTEG-ID-r17 field within the TxTEG-Association-r17 structure, which associates one or more SRS Positioning Resource IDs (srsPosResourceId-List-r17) with a specific Tx Timing Error Group (TEG) identifier, as defined in 3GPP TS 38.331 clause 6.3.2 (UEPositioningAssistanceInfo-r17 IE).

results.question: How should a UE handle a DRB that is included in the drb-CountMSB-InfoList of the CounterCheck message but is NOT currently established, according to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.6.3?

options.A: Ignore it and do not include it in the CounterCheckResponse.
options.B: Include it in the drb-CountInfoList with count-Uplink and count-Downlink set to TX_NEXT and RX_NEXT.
options.C: Include it in the drb-CountInfoList with the most significant bits set identical to the values in drb-CountMSB-InfoList and the least significant bits set to zero.
options.D: Assume COUNT values of 0 for both directions and include it.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.6.3, Reception of the CounterCheck message by the UE
results.evidence: TS 38.331 §5.3.6.3 states that the UE shall, for each DRB that is contained in the drb-CountMSB-InfoList *and for which a DRB with the same value of drb-Identity is established*, compare the COUNT value; DRBs listed in drb-CountMSB-InfoList that are not established are therefore not acted upon and are effectively ignored by the UE (i.e., they are not included in the CounterCheckResponse).

results.question: When SIB20 is provided by the PCell, what triggers the UE to transmit an MBS Interest Indication message?

options.A: When the UE's set of MBS broadcast frequencies of interest changes
options.B: When the UE connects to a PCell that previously broadcast SIB20 but now broadcasts SIB21
options.C: When the set of MBS broadcast services of interest differs from the last transmitted mbs-ServiceList
options.D: When the UE's prioritisation between MBS broadcast and unicast reception changes

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The UE initiates the MBS Interest Indication procedure by submitting the MBSInterestIndication message to lower layers for transmission, upon any of the following (as applicable), when SIB20 is broadcast by the PCell: upon entering RRC_CONNECTED (e.g. upon completion of RRC connection establishment/resume/handover/reconfiguration with sync) if the UE is interested in receiving, or continuing to receive, one or more MBS broadcast services via MRB(s); upon a change of the MBS frequencies of interest or the MBS FSAI(s) of interest (e.g. due to the UE starting or stopping interest in one or more MBS broadcast services, or due to a change of MBS broadcast service being provided on a frequency) while the UE remains in RRC_CONNECTED and SIB20 continues to be broadcast by the PCell; and upon the PCell starting to broadcast SIB20 when it was not previously broadcasting SIB20 (i.e. change to a PCell providing SIB20), while the UE has MBS frequencies or MBS FSAI(s) of interest.

results.question: Under what condition must a UE in RRC_CONNECTED acquire the MIB according to clause 5.2.2.3.1?

options.A: When the UE has an active BWP with common search space configured by searchSpaceSIB1
options.B: When T311 is running
options.C: When the UE has received an indication about change of system information
options.D: When the UE has not stored a valid version of a required SIB

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.1, Acquisition of MIB and SIB1
results.evidence: A UE in RRC_CONNECTED shall apply the MIB acquisition procedure specified in clause 5.2.2.3.1 to acquire the MIB of the PCell only if the UE needs to acquire the timing information (SFN) of that cell, e.g. upon receiving an RRCReconfiguration message including reconfigurationWithSync (handover/PCell change) or upon selecting/reselecting that cell, unless the UE already has a valid stored version of the MIB for that cell.

results.question: When a UE is in (NG)EN-DC and SRB3 is configured with SCG not deactivated, how should the MeasurementReport message be submitted?

options.A: Via SRB1 embedded in NR RRC message ULInformationTransferMRDC
options.B: Via SRB3 to lower layers for transmission
options.C: Via SRB1 to lower layers for transmission
options.D: Via SRB2 embedded in E-UTRA RRC message ULInformationTransferIRAT

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.5.1, General MeasurementReport
results.evidence: The UE shall submit the MeasurementReport message via SRB1 or split SRB, except for the case when SRB3 is configured and the associated measurements are configured by the SCG, in which case the UE shall submit the MeasurementReport message via SRB3 when SCG is not deactivated, upon which the procedure ends.

results.question: For a UE in NR-DC where the measurement configuration that triggered the report is associated with the SCG, and SRB3 is configured with SCG not deactivated, what happens after submitting the MeasurementReport via SRB3?

options.A: The UE must also submit the message via SRB1 embedded in ULInformationTransferMRDC
options.B: The procedure ends after submission via SRB3
options.C: The UE must wait for acknowledgment from the network before ending the procedure
options.D: The UE must submit the same message via E-UTRA embedded in ULInformationTransferIRAT

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.5.1, General MeasurementReport
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> if SRB3 is configured and SCG is not deactivated and the measurement configuration that triggered this measurement report is associated with the SCG: 2> submit the MeasurementReport message via SRB3 to lower layers for transmission, upon which the procedure ends;

results.question: When processing a received measObject that includes a cellsToAddModList, and an entry with a matching physCellId already exists in the UE's cellsToAddModList, what is the UE's required action according to TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.2.5?

options.A: Ignore the received entry and keep the existing one.
options.B: Remove the existing entry and add the new one.
options.C: Replace the entry with the value received for this physCellId.
options.D: Add the received entry as a duplicate in the list.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.5, Measurement object addition/modification
results.evidence: For each entry included in the received cellsToAddModList: if an entry with the matching physCellId exists in the cellsToAddModList within the VarMeasConfig for this measObject: 1> replace the entry with the value received for this cellId;

results.question: For an established DRB where the drb-Identity is NOT included in the drb-CountMSB-InfoList of the received CounterCheck message, what action must the UE take according to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.6.3?

options.A: Do not include the DRB in the CounterCheckResponse message.
options.B: Include the DRB in the drb-CountInfoList with count-Uplink and count-Downlink set to the values of TX_NEXT and RX_NEXT respectively.
options.C: Include the DRB in the drb-CountInfoList with the most significant bits set as in drb-CountMSB-InfoList and least significant bits set to zero.
options.D: Assume the COUNT value is 0 for both directions and include it.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.6.3, Reception of the CounterCheck message by the UE
results.evidence: For each DRB that is established, if the drb-Identity is not included in the drb-CountMSB-InfoList in the received CounterCheck message, the UE shall: set both the COUNT MSB value for uplink and the COUNT MSB value for downlink to 0 in the drb-CountInfo for this DRB included in the counterCheckResponse message.

results.question: What is the prerequisite bearer condition specified in clause 5.3.4.2 for the network to apply the security mode command procedure?

options.A: SRB2 must be established first
options.B: At least one DRB must be established
options.C: Only SRB1 is established
options.D: Both SRB1 and SRB2 must be established

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.4.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The network applies the security mode command procedure as follows: the network initiates the security mode command procedure only when there is no ongoing AS security context re-establishment or intra 5G security algorithm change on the concerned RRC connection, and only after successful AS security activation... The network applies the procedure only after the SRB1 is suspended or established, and there is no other bearer established other than SRB1.

results.question: What condition triggers the inclusion of mbs-ServiceList in the MBS Interest Indication?

options.A: When the UE supports MBS over SC-PTM
options.B: When the set of MBS frequencies of interest is empty
options.C: When SIB20 is scheduled by the PCell
options.D: When the UE is in MBSFN area

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.5, Setting of the contents of MBS Interest Indication
results.evidence: mbs-ServiceList is included when the UE is interested in receiving MBS multicast/broadcast services and includes the list of MBS services (identified by TMGIs) that the UE is interested to receive, or continue to receive, via MRB(s) either in RRC_CONNECTED (for multicast) or via broadcast reception, upon change of the UE's interest (e.g. due to UE entering/leaving service area, upper layers indicating interest change, or the UE receiving system information indicating MBS broadcast/multicast availability), as specified in TS 38.331 clause 5.x for MBSInterestIndication.

results.question: Under what RRC state does the network initiate the security mode command procedure to a UE according to clause 5.3.4.2?

options.A: RRC_IDLE
options.B: RRC_INACTIVE
options.C: RRC_CONNECTED
options.D: RRC_RELEASED

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.4.2, Initiation
results.evidence: The network initiates the security mode command procedure to a UE in RRC_CONNECTED.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.5.1, when can a UE initiate the MeasurementReport procedure?

options.A: Immediately after receiving the measurement configuration from the network
options.B: Only after successful AS security activation
options.C: When the UE enters RRC_CONNECTED state
options.D: After receiving explicit triggering from the network via PDCCH

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.5.1, General MeasurementReport
results.evidence: The UE shall initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as described below, when a measurement reporting event as configured within the corresponding reportConfig associated to the measId is detected, i.e., when the entry/leave condition applicable for that event is met, or when the corresponding periodical reporting timer expires, provided that AS security has been activated and the UE has a valid measConfig.

results.question: When the UE applies the timing advance mgta to measurement gap occurrences, what does this cause?

options.A: The UE ends the measurement mgta ms after the gap subframe occurrences
options.B: The UE starts the measurement mgta ms before the gap subframe occurrences
options.C: The UE extends the gap duration by mgta ms
options.D: The UE shifts the entire gap pattern by mgta subframes

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.9, Measurement gap configuration
results.evidence: Applying the timing advance mgta to measurement gap occurrences causes the actual start time of a measurement gap to occur mgta ms earlier than the gap timing calculated using the formula (SFN, subframe) defined in TS 38.133, i.e. the gap starts and ends mgta ms in advance of the nominal gap occasion, which may result in the measurement gap overlapping with the end of the preceding gap-free period.

results.question: According to 3GPP TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.4.17, what triggers Event X1?

options.A: Serving L2 U2N Relay UE becomes better than threshold1 and NR Cell becomes worse than threshold2
options.B: Serving L2 U2N Relay UE becomes worse than threshold1 and NR Cell becomes better than threshold2
options.C: Serving L2 U2N Relay UE becomes better than threshold1 and NR Cell becomes better than threshold2
options.D: Serving L2 U2N Relay UE becomes worse than threshold1 and NR Cell becomes worse than threshold2

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.17, Event X1 (Serving L2 U2N Relay UE becomes worse than threshold1 and NR Cell becomes better than threshold2)
results.evidence: Event X1 (Approaching a configured geographical area boundary): The UE shall consider itself to be approaching a configured geographical area boundary if condition X1-1, as specified below, is fulfilled. Condition X1-1 (Distance from the reference location greater than distanceThreshFromReference): The distance between the UE's current location and the referenceLocation, as specified in referenceLocationList within commonLocationInfo, becomes greater than or equal to the configured distanceThreshFromReference.

results.question: Based on clause 5.3.4.2, which of the following scenarios triggers the network to apply the security mode command procedure?

options.A: When SRB2 is already established but DRBs are not
options.B: When only SRB1 is established and no other bearers exist
options.C: When multicast MRBs are established before SRB1
options.D: When the UE is transitioning from RRC_INACTIVE to RRC_CONNECTED

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.4.2, Initiation
results.evidence: Prior to the RRCReconfiguration message with the reconfigurationWithSync in the masterCellGroup, i.e. at the time of performing intra 5GC handover, the network applies the security mode command procedure and reconfigures the SRB2 and DRBs that are established.

results.question: For a received measObject that includes an ssb-PositionQCL-CellsToRemoveList, what does the UE do for each physCellId in that list, as per TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.2.5?

options.A: Remove the entry with the matching physCellId from the ssb-PositionQCL-CellsToAddModList.
options.B: Remove the entry with the matching physCellId from the cellsToAddModList.
options.C: Add a new entry for the received physCellId to the ssb-PositionQCL-CellsToAddModList.
options.D: Replace the entry with the value received for this physCellId in the ssb-PositionQCL-CellsToAddModList.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.5, Measurement object addition/modification
results.evidence: For each physCellId value included in the ssb-PositionQCL-CellsToRemoveList, if any, the UE shall remove the entry with the matching physCellId from the ssb-PositionQCL-CellList within the VarMeasConfig for this measObjectId.

results.question: When does the UE include the mbs-Priority field in the MBS Interest Indication?

options.A: When SIB20 is scheduled by the PCell
options.B: When the UE prioritizes reception of all indicated MBS frequencies above unicast bearers and multicast MRBs
options.C: When the set of MBS frequencies of interest contains more than one frequency
options.D: When the UE is configured with MR-DC

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.5, Setting of the contents of MBS Interest Indication
results.evidence: The UE shall set the mbs-Priority field in the MBSInterestIndication message to indicate that it prioritizes reception of the MBS frequency(ies) it is interested in over the establishment/maintenance of any of its unicast bearer services, i.e., the UE includes mbs-Priority only if it gives priority to MBS broadcast reception over unicast services.

results.question: In Event X1, what condition must be met regarding the NR Cell?

options.A: NR Cell becomes worse than threshold2
options.B: NR Cell becomes better than threshold1
options.C: NR Cell becomes better than threshold2
options.D: NR Cell becomes worse than threshold1

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.17, Event X1 (Serving L2 U2N Relay UE becomes worse than threshold1 and NR Cell becomes better than threshold2)
results.evidence: The UE shall consider the NR cell that triggers the event to be one that is not excluded because of the NR cell being barred or reserved, i.e., the NR neighbour cell measured for Event X1 shall not be a cell for which cellBarred is set to barred or cellReservedForOperatorUse is applicable to the UE.

results.question: When is a UE in RRC_CONNECTED required to acquire SIB1, assuming SIB1 is transmitted in the cell and SIB1 acquisition is required?

options.A: Always, regardless of unicast data reception
options.B: Only if the UE has not stored a valid version of a required SIB and si-BroadcastStatus is set to broadcasting
options.C: Only if the UE can acquire it without disrupting unicast or MBS multicast data reception
options.D: Only when T311 is running

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.1, Acquisition of MIB and SIB1
results.evidence: A UE in RRC_CONNECTED, assuming SIB1 is broadcast in the cell and SIB1 acquisition is required, shall apply the SIB1 acquisition procedure specified in clause 5.2.2.3.1 of TS 38.331 in the following cases: upon connection establishment; upon connection re-establishment; upon connection resume from RRC_INACTIVE; upon reception of RRCReconfiguration including reconfigurationWithSync (i.e., handover) to the concerned cell; upon receiving an indication (e.g., via short message on PDCCH or a change of the value tag) that the system information of the cell has changed; upon exceeding the maximum validity duration of the previously acquired SIB1; and upon returning to the cell after having been absent from that cell for a period longer than the SIB1 validity/modification period.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.2, under which condition can a UE in RRC_CONNECTED state perform NR sidelink communication operation?

options.A: Only if the serving cell is suitable and the UE is out of coverage on the sidelink frequency
options.B: Only if the serving cell is suitable and the selected cell on the sidelink frequency belongs to registered/equivalent PLMN
options.C: Only if the serving cell is suitable and either the selected cell on sidelink frequency belongs to registered/equivalent PLMN OR the UE is out of coverage on that frequency
options.D: Only if the serving cell supports limited service state and is on the sidelink frequency

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.2, Conditions for NR sidelink communication operation
results.evidence: A UE in RRC_CONNECTED state can perform NR sidelink communication operation only if AS layer is configured by upper layers to do so, and the UE has received either the necessary sidelink configuration via dedicated signalling (i.e. RRCReconfiguration including sl-ConfigDedicatedNR) from the serving cell, or the serving cell broadcasts SIB12 including sl-ConfigCommonNR, and NR sidelink communication is not restricted by the network (i.e. no sl-ConfigDedicatedNR indicating that the UE shall not perform NR sidelink communication has been received).

results.question: Which of the following is a mandatory IE that must be included in the RRC connection reject message as per clause 5.3.15?

options.A: waitTime
options.B: rejectCause
options.C: redirectedCarrierInfo
options.D: extendedWaitTime

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.5.6.4, when the UE processes a drb-ToReleaseList that includes a drb-Identity value NOT part of the current UE configuration, how should the UE treat this situation?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.6.4, DRB release
results.evidence: The UE shall perform the following actions for each drb-Identity value included in the drb-ToReleaseList that is part of the current UE configuration: release the PDCP entity and the drb-Identity for the corresponding DRB; indicate the release of the DRB and, if the DRB is a split DRB, of the PDCP duplication to upper layers. results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.3.8.2, under what condition can the network initiate an RRC connection release to transition a UE from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_INACTIVE?

results.evidence: The network initiates an RRC connection release to RRC_INACTIVE only if AS context of the UE is available in the network, i.e., only for UEs in RRC_CONNECTED for which the UE's AS context has been established, and the network can retrieve the UE context for the concerned UE (e.g. based on I-RNTI) if the UE is to send an RRCResumeRequest message to resume the connection or to send an RRCResumeRequest message to perform an RNA update.

results.question: What is the primary purpose of the FailureInformation message as specified in TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.5?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.5, Failure information
results.evidence: The purpose of the FailureInformation message, as specified in TS 38.331 Clause 5.7.5 (Failure Information procedure), is to inform the network (gNB) about a failure detected by the UE that is not covered by another more specific failure reporting procedure (such as RLF or SCG failure reporting). This includes failures such as RLC failure, failure related to conditional reconfiguration, measurement gap failure, or other UE-detected failure types defined by the failureType IE, allowing the network to take appropriate corrective action.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.3.3, which of the following is a valid trigger for a UE to initiate the procedure to transmit a SidelinkUEInformationNR message?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.3, Actions related to transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR message
results.evidence: The UE shall initiate the procedure to transmit a SidelinkUEInformationNR message in the following cases: upon change of any of the parameters relevant for sidelink communication (e.g. upon change of sidelink communication interest, upon change of a related traffic pattern, upon change to the required RB, upon change of destinations, upon change of QoS parameters, etc.), or upon successful completion of a handover procedure, or upon successful completion of an RRC re-establishment or resume procedure, or upon request from upper layers to transmit sidelink communication and no destinations were previously configured or upon request from upper layers to change or add sidelink discovery information, or upon change of the parameters relevant for sidelink discovery, or upon a request from upper layers to stop sidelink communication/discovery for a certain destination, or upon change of NR sidelink communication/discovery related capability, or upon entering or leaving a frequency configured for NR sidelink communication/discovery.

If AS security has not been activated, the UE does not initiate the procedure. results.question: For a RedCap UE that is unable to acquire SIB1 while in RRC_INACTIVE, how does it perform barring according to Clause 5.2.2.5?

results.question: What does the specification state regarding a UE's requirement to monitor PDCCH monitoring occasions corresponding to each transmitted SSB in the SI window?

options.A: The UE must monitor PDCCH for all transmitted SSBs in the SI window
options.B: The UE is not required to monitor PDCCH monitoring occasion(s) corresponding to each transmitted SSB in SI-window
options.C: The UE must monitor only the PDCCH occasions corresponding to the strongest SSB
options.D: The UE must monitor PDCCH for at least half of the transmitted SSBs

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.2, Acquisition of an SI message
results.evidence: The UE is required to monitor PDCCH monitoring occasions for scheduling of the SI message within the associated SI-window. The UE shall monitor PDCCH monitoring occasion(s) corresponding to each transmitted SSB in the SI-window, i.e. the UE is not required to monitor PDCCH monitoring occasions that do not overlap with, or correspond to, a transmitted SSB. For each transmitted SSB, at least one PDCCH monitoring occasion for the SI message shall be provided within the SI-window, and the UE may assume that the same SI message content is transmitted in all such monitoring occasions corresponding to different transmitted SSBs within that SI-window.
